Why We Exist
Our Reason For Being
Saatvik Green Energy exists to accelerate India's transition to clean, dependable energy. Founded on a vision to provide world-class solar solutions, we build high-efficiency modules that power homes, businesses, and utility-scale projects across the country and beyond.
From our state-of-the-art facilities in Ambala, Haryana, our vertically integrated operations ensure complete quality control from cell to module — driven by a relentless commitment to innovation, sustainability, and the communities we serve.

Our Mission & Vision
Our Vision
To be amidst the world's most trusted and admired clean energy companies, empowering a sustainable future through decarbonisation solutions.
Our Mission
To deliver zero-defect, technology-led renewable energy solutions that accelerate global decarbonisation by building a fully integrated, carbon-neutral enterprise powered by patented R&D, digital efficiency, and global manufacturing. We aim to be a trusted clean-energy brand for consumers, a benchmark in service leadership, and an employer of choice by advancing innovation, quality, and sustainable impact worldwide.

Product Overview
Smart & Reliable Li-ion Inverter Battery
Saatvik UDAY Shakti is a Li-ion inverter battery for home energy storage and backup. It saves energy from the sun and gives power when required. The battery is durable, easy to install and safe. With 5.12 kWh capacity and 4000+ life cycles, it is suitable for regular use.
The UDAY Shakti uses LFP technology for better safety and performance. It comes with a Smart BMS, which helps keep the battery safe during charging and discharging, and active balancing to maintain the cells properly. The wall-mounted design makes it easy to install and saves space.
It can support up to 16 batteries in parallel, so storage can be increased when needed — designed for simple, safe use across a range of energy storage needs.

title: Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) — Saatvik Green Energy
description: Saatvik Battery Energy Storage Systems — containerized LFP storage for grid balancing, peak shaving, renewable firming and C&I backup, with ~95% round-trip efficiency and multi-MWh scalability.
headings: Storage That Powers the Energy Transition
Ready To Switch To Solar With Saatvik?

faqs.q: What is a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)?
faqs.a: A BESS stores electrical energy in battery cells — typically Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) — and releases it when needed. Saatvik's containerized systems combine batteries, power conversion, thermal management and control software into factory-integrated blocks that can be deployed for grid, solar and industrial applications.

faqs.q: What is peak shaving and how does BESS help?
faqs.a: Peak shaving means discharging stored energy during the most expensive or most constrained hours of the day, reducing peak-demand charges and stress on the grid. A BESS charges when power is cheap or solar generation is abundant, then discharges during evening peaks — cutting energy costs without changing how you operate.

faqs.q: Why does Saatvik use LFP battery chemistry?
faqs.a: LFP cells offer excellent thermal stability, long cycle life of 6,000+ cycles and strong safety characteristics, making them the preferred chemistry for stationary storage. Combined with round-trip efficiency of around 95%, LFP delivers the lowest levelized cost of storage over a 15+ year design life.

faqs.q: Can BESS be combined with an existing solar plant?
faqs.a: Yes. Saatvik retrofits storage to operating solar plants (AC-coupled) or integrates it into new builds (DC- or AC-coupled). Storage firms up solar output, shifts energy into peak hours and helps meet firm dispatchable renewable energy requirements — all managed by a single EMS.

faqs.q: What sizes of BESS does Saatvik deliver?

Frequently Asked Questions
What is a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)?+
A BESS stores electrical energy in battery cells — typically Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) — and releases it when needed. Saatvik's containerized systems combine batteries, power conversion, thermal management and control software into factory-integrated blocks that can be deployed for grid, solar and industrial applications.
What is peak shaving and how does BESS help?+
Peak shaving means discharging stored energy during the most expensive or most constrained hours of the day, reducing peak-demand charges and stress on the grid. A BESS charges when power is cheap or solar generation is abundant, then discharges during evening peaks — cutting energy costs without changing how you operate.
Why does Saatvik use LFP battery chemistry?+
LFP cells offer excellent thermal stability, long cycle life of 6,000+ cycles and strong safety characteristics, making them the preferred chemistry for stationary storage. Combined with round-trip efficiency of around 95%, LFP delivers the lowest levelized cost of storage over a 15+ year design life.
Can BESS be combined with an existing solar plant?+
Yes. Saatvik retrofits storage to operating solar plants (AC-coupled) or integrates it into new builds (DC- or AC-coupled). Storage firms up solar output, shifts energy into peak hours and helps meet firm dispatchable renewable energy requirements — all managed by a single EMS.
What sizes of BESS does Saatvik deliver?+
Systems are modular: a single 20-ft container stores up to 5 MWh, and multiple containers combine into utility-scale plants of 100 MWh and beyond. Saatvik's EPC team handles sizing, design, installation, commissioning and long-term operations and maintenance.

Careers
Build the Future of Energy
Join the team powering India's solar transition — from Ambala to the world.
Why Join Saatvik
Grow With India's Solar Story
Saatvik provides an environment in which to work and flourish, with numerous possibilities to learn and develop. From a work culture that gives truly equal opportunities to a collegiality that extends as far as sharing even the slightest delight together.
With 4.8 GW of module capacity in Ambala and a 4 GW module + 6 GW cell expansion underway in Odisha, we are hiring across every function — and promoting from within as we scale.

Saatvik becomes Saatvik because of the people. Life here isn't only the workplace — it's a space where passion, growth, and collaboration together shape remarkable journeys.
A Workplace People Love
We're proud to be recognised as a Great Place to Work in 2025 — a testament to our people-laden culture, prosperous environment, and strong commitment to employee well-being.
Culture Rooted in Trust & Growth
Saatvik promotes open communication, mutual respect, and equal growth opportunities for everyone. From month-end celebrations to team huddles, every voice matters and is encouraged to contribute.
A Place to Learn, Lead & Flourish
An open environment where learning flourishes. Everyone gets hands-on opportunities for upskilling — Saatvik supports every team member and pushes them to experience their full potential.
Together We Celebrate
From festivals to team outings, and from milestones to achievements, we celebrate each other across the Saatvik family — turning every success personal and every day memorable.

text:
ESG
Sustainability at Saatvik
Powering progress: growing together for a greener future.
Our Approach
At Saatvik, sustainability is embedded in our business strategy, operations, value chain and product innovation. As a solar PV module manufacturer and integrated clean energy solutions provider, we are committed to responsible growth that creates long-term value for the environment, people and all stakeholders.
Our sustainability approach is governed through Board-approved policies and an ESG Council led by the Chief Executive Officer. Our disclosures align with SEBI's Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting (BRSR) framework and the National Guidelines on Responsible Business Conduct (NGRBC), while drawing on the GRI 2021 Standards and the UN Sustainable Development Goals, where relevant.
Three Pillars
Our ESG Framework
E
Environmental Sustainability
Reducing environmental impact through energy efficiency, renewable energy integration, responsible resource management, and circular-economy practices. All manufacturing facilities are ISO 14001 certified, with continuous monitoring of emissions, energy, water, and waste.
Climate action & GHG reduction
Renewable energy consumption
Water stewardship & Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD)
Waste & circular economy management
Biodiversity & green infrastructure
Product environmental stewardship
S
Social Responsibility
Our people and communities are central to our success. We provide safe, inclusive, and equitable workplaces, uphold human rights across operations and supply chains, and invest in community development initiatives.
Occupational health and safety
Employee learning, wellbeing, and diversity
Human rights and ethical labour practices
CSR programs in healthcare, education & clean energy access
Community development & CSR impact
G
Governance & Ethics
Aligned with the SEBI BRSR framework, NGRBC principles, and GRI 2021 Standards, our governance model promotes transparency, accountability, and ethical conduct — with Board-level oversight of ESG, financial, and operational performance.
Board-level ESG oversight & policy framework
Code of conduct & anti-corruption controls
Cybersecurity and data protection systems
Whistleblower & grievance redressal mechanisms
Verified Impact
A Third-Party Verified Environmental Product Declaration
Saatvik has published an independently verified Environmental Product Declaration for its N-TOPCon Bifacial G12R module under The International EPD® System (Registration No. EPD-IES-0028392) — full lifecycle transparency, from cradle to gate.

Structured Transparency
Sustainability Report FY 2024–25
Our inaugural Sustainability Report — prepared with reference to the GRI 2021 Standards and aligned with the SEBI BRSR framework and the UN SDGs — covers our climate action and decarbonisation roadmap, operational performance across energy, water, waste, and emissions, product lifecycle transparency including LCA and EPD disclosures, and our social impact and CSR initiatives. We will publish it annually, progressively expanding value-chain coverage.
Download the Report
Recognition
Green Manufacturing, ESG Ratings & Safety Recognition
Independent recognition of how we build — resource-efficient factories, a globally benchmarked ESG rating, and an award-winning safety culture.
Green Manufacturing
IGBC Green Factory Building — Silver Rating
An Ambala manufacturing facility received the IGBC Green Factory Building Silver Rating from the Indian Green Building Council, part of the Confederation of Indian Industry. The rating recognises resource efficiency, environmental management and sustainable-building practices within our manufacturing operations.
ESG Rating
EcoVadis Bronze Medal
Saatvik received its first EcoVadis Bronze Medal with a score of 69/100, placing the Company in the 79th percentile globally among assessed companies. The assessment covered Environment, Labour and Human Rights, Ethics, and Sustainable Procurement.
Safety Recognition
Golden Peacock Occupational Health & Safety Award 2026
Saatvik received the Golden Peacock Occupational Health & Safety Award 2026 in the Power (Renewable) sector, recognising the Company's safety culture, governance systems and continuous improvement across its Ambala manufacturing operations.
As we scale manufacturing capacity and expand globally, we will continue strengthening ESG systems, advancing decarbonisation, enhancing responsible sourcing, and increasing transparency across operations and products. Together, we are powering progress — responsibly.

headings: Saatvik Social Foundation — Corporate Social Responsibility
More Than a Story. It’s a Movement.
Laying the Cornerstone for a Sustainable India
Greening the Grid with Solar PV Systems
Fostering Rural Growth for a Stronger Tomorrow

text:
Saatvik Social Foundation — Corporate Social Responsibility
Our Responsibility
More Than a Story. It’s a Movement.
At Saatvik Solar it isn’t just a normal initiative or a formality; it is the essence of who we are. Our journey begins with a simple but transforming belief — clean energy should not only power up homes, businesses, and industries, but empower communities, uplift the sanctity of human lives, and nurture the environment.
We understand vividly that it is our responsibility to take care of society and our Nation. Our only end goal should not be to earn profits and fill our pockets, but to give, empower, foster, and shape the world of tomorrow with our social deeds.
Our Journey to Positive Change
Laying the Cornerstone for a Sustainable India
From the outset, Saatvik laid down the cornerstone with the thought to take India towards a sustainable future — not only through solar energy, but by making possible contributions to society. When it comes to the development and progress of the Nation, Saatvik never took a step back.
Over the years, our commitment has evolved beyond solar modules. We pave our way to classrooms, healthcare, and rural landscapes — not only for infrastructure expansion but for inspiration. From setting up smart classrooms in underdeveloped schools to installing RO water units, and from cleanliness drives to conducting free medical check-ups for communities, every step we take in CSR showcases our vision of an equal, educated, and healthier India.
We shake hands with local organizations, educators, social workers, and changemakers to ensure that our impact really has meaning. Our CSR efforts dwell in the notions of sustainability, inclusivity, and empowerment — echoing the values we strive to bring to renewable energy. This is more than a story. It's a movement. It's Saatvik's promise — to energize every life we touch.
Mission & Vision
What Drives Us Forward
Mission
We look forward to bringing a change in the future of India — not only with our solar efforts but with our social acts. Our mission is to help people get hold of things that they can’t attain.
Vision
Saatvik’s vision is to improve community and environmental sustainability through our clean energy and CSR efforts. We imagine a tomorrow filled with harmony, unity, and happiness.
Our Positive Footprints
Glimpses of Our CSR Efforts
Saatvik Solar’s CSR program has touched the lives of tens of thousands of people so far — but there is still a long way to go. The more we do to reform the community, the less it seems. It shouldn’t be measured; only the impact should be seen.
Greening the Grid with Solar PV Systems
We not only stay by our words but live up to them. We installed solar PV systems to ensure a beginning towards a cleaner and greener future — at Dr Jai Dev Memorial Rotary Ambala Hospital (Ambala Cantt), Bal Gopal Gaushala (Mohali), and MDSD College (Ambala Cantt).
Bridging Gaps Through Education
Education is indeed the base of everything; thus, Saatvik Solar takes care of it as a priority. We offer sponsorship to the needy students of Bhartiya Vidya Mandir, Chandigarh, and — to take a leap for a promising future — installed 2 smart classrooms at Rajkiya Vidyalaya, Itawa Bhopji, Rajasthan.
Nurturing Wellbeing, Ensuring Sustainability
Healthcare is a major crisis in society and has a wide gap to focus on. Saatvik moved ahead and executed various acts in this domain — running an eye-care unit for all SC, ST, Minorities, BPL, and OBC of society, and installing an HFNC system for high-flow oxygen therapy at PGIMER, Chandigarh.
Fostering Rural Growth for a Stronger Tomorrow
It is said that the more prosperous the Nation, the more it shows in terms of infrastructure. To not let our nation down, we took charge and built a safe drinking-water facility for the community at Gram Panchayat, Itawa Bhopji, Rajasthan.
Domains Where We Channel Our Efforts
Three Threads, One Fabric
CSR initiatives are not like threads of different colors, sizes, and textures — they are threads of similar type, intertwined in an intact manner to form one specified product. We channel our efforts in a unified manner, with a strategic plan to do something impactful.
Education
Shiksha Vikas
Education is the foremost matter for us. Children must stand on their own and make their way towards a good life. Hence, we not only light up futures with solar energy but also with educational empowerment.
Healthcare
Svaasthya Nivaran
Saatvik Solar strives hard to do as much as we can under healthcare oversight for a balanced tomorrow. Life is precious, and we know it. We never let any stone unturned to keep the sanctity of human life from declining.
Rural Development
Saksham Grameen Bharat
India is the place where we reside, and it is our social responsibility to make it a better place to live. At Saatvik, we always strive to refine the rural fabric of our nation. We aim to form self-reliant villages that lead to a more equitable India.
Built to Perform. Designed to Last.

Utility-Scale EPC
“Saatvik modules have consistently delivered above-rated performance across our utility-scale projects. The quality and after-sales support are unmatched in the industry.”
A utility-scale EPC developer has deployed Saatvik N-TOPCon and Mono PERC modules across ground-mounted plants in Rajasthan's high-irradiance corridor. Flash-test data at commissioning has repeatedly come in above nameplate, and degradation tracking over multiple seasons has stayed comfortably within warranty limits.

Ground-Mounted Solar · Rajasthan
Residential & Commercial Installer
“We've been sourcing Saatvik panels for two years across residential and commercial installs. Their consistency in efficiency and their 30-year warranty give our clients real confidence.”
A rooftop installer sourcing Saatvik panels across Maharashtra reports that, for homeowners weighing a 25-year investment, the 12-year product warranty and 30-year linear performance warranty — backed by Munich RE — have become the deciding factor in closing installations.
RSI
Rooftop Solar Installer
Residential & Commercial · Maharashtra
Commercial Rooftop
“The Uday Series inverters have been rock-solid in our commercial rooftop deployments. Saatvik truly understands the complete solar ecosystem.”
A C&I rooftop partner pairs Saatvik modules with Uday Series three-phase inverters on factory and warehouse rooftops across Gujarat. Running modules and inverters from a single manufacturer has simplified O&M, spares, and warranty management for their commercial clients.
CRP
Commercial Rooftop Partner
C&I Solar · Gujarat
Homeowner
“Our monthly electricity bill has dropped by nearly 80%. The SuryaConnect kit was installed in two days and has run without a hiccup since.”
A Karnal household chose a SuryaConnect Solar Kit through a local Saatvik dealer — DCR modules, on-grid inverter, ACDB/DCDB, and earthing in one package. Net metering was commissioned within weeks, and the system now covers most of the household's daytime consumption.
RKH

5 kW Rooftop System · Karnal, Haryana
Farmer — Solar Pumps
“Diesel used to eat into every harvest. With the Saatvik solar pump, irrigation now costs nothing to run — and it works right through the day.”
Under the PM-KUSUM scheme, a Bathinda farmer replaced a diesel pump with a Saatvik DC submersible solar pump. Reliable daytime irrigation across the holding has cut input costs and removed fuel logistics — with a 5-year warranty for peace of mind.
SPF
Solar Pump Farmer
7.5 HP Solar Pump · Bathinda, Punjab
Institutional
“For a hospital, power reliability is non-negotiable. Saatvik's EPC team engineered a rooftop system that has performed exactly as modelled.”
Saatvik's EPC division delivered a turnkey rooftop installation across a hospital campus — from structural audit and design to commissioning. Generation has tracked the P50 estimate closely, trimming the group's daytime grid draw and its long-term energy costs.

faqs.q: How do I raise a complaint about a Saatvik solar module?
faqs.a: Email crm.solarmodule@saatvikgroup.com with your module serial number, purchase invoice, and photos of the issue, or call 1800-547-1151. You will receive a ticket reference within 24 working hours.

faqs.q: What warranty do Saatvik modules carry?
faqs.a: Saatvik modules carry a 12-year product warranty and a linear performance warranty of 25 years (Mono PERC) to 30 years (N-TOPCon), with annual degradation capped under 0.40% and Munich RE as warranty partner.

faqs.q: Is installation support available in my city?
faqs.a: Yes. Saatvik has a pan-India network of 500+ dealer and service touchpoints. Our team coordinates on-site support for installation and commissioning through the nearest certified partner.

faqs.q: How long does a service request take to resolve?
faqs.a: Most requests receive a first response within 24 working hours and are resolved within about 7 working days, depending on inspection needs and spare availability. Complex warranty claims may take longer.

faqs.q: Do inverters and pumps get after-sales support too?
faqs.a: Yes. Uday Series grid-tie inverters carry a 10-year warranty, the UDAY Plus hybrid inverter 5 years, and solar pumps 5 years — all backed by the same toll-free helpline and pan-India service and spares network.

Floating Solar

Saatvik's floating solar solutions are engineered for reservoirs, lakes, and industrial ponds — reducing water evaporation while producing power. Our marine-grade floating platforms, mooring systems, and corrosion-resistant components are designed for 25+ year operational life in aquatic environments.

Carport & BESS
Combine solar carport structures with battery energy storage systems for round-the-clock clean power. Saatvik designs and installs integrated carport-plus-storage solutions for commercial parks, airports, and institutional campuses. description: Transform parking spaces into powerful energy hubs with Saatvik's solar carport EPC — shade and vehicle protection plus clean energy, with EV-charging and battery storage integration for offices, malls, and campuses.
headings: Every Parking Bay, A Power Plant
From Parking Lot to Power Hub in Four Steps
Generate Power. Protect Vehicles. One Solution.
Pair Your Carport With Battery Storage
Ready To Switch To Solar With Saatvik?

faqs.q: How much power can a solar carport generate?
faqs.a: Each standard car bay supports roughly 3–3.5 kWp of modules, so a 100-bay parking lot can host a 300–350 kWp plant — often enough to cover a significant share of an office building's daytime load.

faqs.q: Can EV chargers be integrated with the carport?
faqs.a: Yes — carports are a natural fit for EV charging. We provision cable trays, load capacity, and charger mounting in the structural design, and can integrate battery energy storage (BESS) for charging beyond daylight hours and peak-demand management.

faqs.q: Will my parking be unusable during construction?
faqs.a: No. Structures are pre-fabricated off site and erected in phases, so most of your parking stays operational throughout. Foundations and lifting work are sequenced around your site's hours.

faqs.q: Are solar carports safe in high winds and storms?
faqs.a: Yes. Our galvanised steel structures are engineered to relevant IS wind-load codes for your location, with certified foundations and a 25-year structural design life — protecting both vehicles and the array.

faqs.q: What does a solar carport cost compared to rooftop solar?
faqs.a: Carports cost more per kWp than rooftop systems because of the steel structure, but they monetise land that generates nothing today, add vehicle protection and EV-charging value, and qualify for the same incentives — accelerated depreciation included. We provide a detailed cost-benefit model during consultation.

description: Advanced floating solar solutions from Saatvik Green Energy — transform reservoirs, dams, and lakes into efficient power generators with higher yield, lower evaporation, and turnkey EPC delivery.
headings: Power From Water. Proof in Numbers.
More Yield. Less Land. Saved Water.
Every reservoir is a power plant waiting to happen.
Ready To Switch To Solar With Saatvik?

faqs.q: Which water bodies suit floating solar?
faqs.a: Reservoirs, dams, irrigation tanks, lakes, and industrial ponds with relatively stable water levels are ideal. Our bathymetric and hydrological survey assesses depth, level variation, wind exposure, and bed conditions before we design the array.

faqs.q: Does floating solar really generate more than land-based solar?
faqs.a: Yes — the water's natural cooling effect keeps module temperatures lower, typically lifting energy yield by 5–10% compared to an equivalent ground-mounted plant, while also slowing thermal degradation of the modules.

faqs.q: Does it harm the water body or aquatic life?
faqs.a: Floating arrays typically cover only part of the surface. The shading reduces evaporation by up to 70% under the covered area and curbs algae growth, while mooring layouts and spacing are designed to maintain oxygen exchange and minimise impact on aquatic life.

faqs.q: How are the panels anchored and maintained on water?
faqs.a: Arrays sit on UV-resistant HDPE floats moored to the bank or bed with engineered anchoring rated for wind, waves, and seasonal water-level swings. Floating walkways allow safe access for cleaning and maintenance, and our O&M teams follow specialised water-side safety protocols.

faqs.q: What scale can floating solar reach in India?
faqs.a: Utility scale — the 100 MW Ramagundam Floating Solar Project in Telangana, spread across roughly 500 acres of reservoir, is among India's largest and shows what floating PV can deliver. Saatvik designs and executes floating solutions from sub-MW industrial ponds to multi-MW reservoir plants.

faqs.q: What project sizes does Saatvik execute for ground-mounted solar?
faqs.a: Our ground-mounted EPC capability spans 1 MW captive plants for industry through utility-scale parks of 100 MW and beyond — including our flagship 100 MW project at the Raghanseda Solar Park. Every project gets the same integrated engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning discipline.

faqs.q: How much land does a ground-mounted solar plant need?
faqs.a: As a rule of thumb, 4–5 acres per MW for fixed-tilt systems with modern high-wattage modules. Our design team optimises layout, pitch, and module selection to maximise yield per acre for your specific site.

faqs.q: Does Saatvik handle land studies and grid connectivity?
faqs.a: Yes. Our scope covers site survey, geotechnical investigation, topographical analysis, and complete grid interconnection — transformers, switchyards, transmission tie-in, and utility approvals.

faqs.q: Fixed-tilt or tracker — which is right for my project?
faqs.a: Trackers can lift generation 15–20% but add capex and maintenance. Our engineers run site-specific yield and LCOE simulations comparing both, and recommend the configuration that delivers the best levelised cost of energy for your irradiance profile and terrain.

faqs.q: What O&M support is available after commissioning?
faqs.a: Comprehensive long-term O&M — module cleaning regimes, vegetation management, preventive and corrective maintenance, spares management, and 24×7 remote monitoring with performance-ratio guarantees.

What project sizes does Saatvik execute for ground-mounted solar?+

How much land does a ground-mounted solar plant need?+
As a rule of thumb, 4–5 acres per MW for fixed-tilt systems with modern high-wattage modules. Our design team optimises layout, pitch, and module selection to maximise yield per acre for your specific site.
Does Saatvik handle land studies and grid connectivity?+

Comprehensive long-term O&M — module cleaning regimes, vegetation management, preventive and corrective maintenance, spares management, and 24×7 remote monitoring with performance-ratio guarantees.

faqs.q: What is the difference between CAPEX and OPEX models?
faqs.a: Under CAPEX, you invest in and own the plant — capturing full savings, accelerated depreciation, and typically a 3–4 year payback. Under OPEX (RESCO), an investor funds the system on your roof and you simply buy the power at a tariff well below your grid rate, with zero upfront investment. Saatvik executes both and helps you model which suits your balance sheet.

faqs.q: How does accelerated depreciation improve returns?
faqs.a: Solar assets qualify for 40% accelerated depreciation under the Income Tax Act. A profit-making company can write off a large share of the plant cost in the first year, reducing taxable income and effectively lowering the net project cost — often improving IRR by several percentage points.

faqs.q: What payback period can my business expect?
faqs.a: Most C&I rooftop systems in India pay back in 3–4 years under the CAPEX model, depending on your tariff, roof type, and state policy. With commercial tariffs of ₹8–11 per unit and solar generation costing ₹2.5–3.5 per unit over the asset life, the economics are compelling.

faqs.q: Will installation disrupt our operations?
faqs.a: No. Our crews plan lifting, cabling, and tie-in work around your production schedule, with shutdowns limited to a brief, pre-agreed window for final grid synchronisation. Strict EHS protocols govern every day on site.

faqs.q: Who maintains the plant after commissioning?
faqs.a: Saatvik offers comprehensive O&M packages — module cleaning, preventive maintenance, inverter servicing, remote monitoring, and performance reporting — with generation guarantees available on long-term contracts.

description: Rooftop solar EPC for schools, hospitals, universities, and government buildings from Saatvik Green Energy. Cut energy costs by up to 50%, match daytime loads, and lead your community's clean-energy transition.
headings: A Campus-Wide Programme, Not Just a Plant
Ready To Switch To Solar With Saatvik?

faqs.q: Why is solar particularly well-suited to institutions?
faqs.a: Schools, hospitals, and offices consume most of their electricity during daylight hours — exactly when solar generates. That load match means up to 80% of solar output is consumed on site, maximising savings without needing storage.

faqs.q: Can government institutions go solar without upfront budget?
faqs.a: Yes. Under the OPEX/RESCO model, a developer installs and owns the plant and the institution simply pays a per-unit tariff lower than the grid rate. Saatvik also assists with applicable central and state scheme benefits for public institutions.

faqs.q: Is installation safe on an operating hospital or school campus?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We sequence work around academic calendars and hospital operations, maintain safety cordons around lifting zones, and complete grid tie-in during pre-agreed low-activity windows so services are never interrupted.

faqs.q: What happens on weekends and holidays when consumption drops?
faqs.a: Surplus generation is exported to the grid through net metering and credited against your bill — so units generated during vacations or weekends are not wasted.

faqs.q: Who maintains the system after handover?
faqs.a: Saatvik trains your facilities team at commissioning and offers long-term O&M contracts covering cleaning, preventive maintenance, and remote performance monitoring — ideal for institutions without in-house technical staff.

title: Residential Rooftop Solar — PM Surya Ghar Subsidy & Net Metering — Saatvik Green Energy
description: Turnkey rooftop solar for homes from Saatvik Green Energy. Cut electricity bills by up to 90%, claim up to ₹78,000 under PM Surya Ghar, and earn net-metering credits — design to commissioning handled end-to-end.
headings: From First Visit to First Unit in Five Steps
Why Saatvik Solar on Your Roof?
Your Home System, Built by India's Solar Leader
Ready To Switch To Solar With Saatvik?

faqs.q: How much does a residential rooftop solar system cost after subsidy?
faqs.a: A typical 3 kW home system costs roughly ₹1.8–2.2 lakh before incentives. With the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana subsidy of up to ₹78,000, your effective outlay drops sharply — and most homeowners recover it in about 4 years through bill savings.

faqs.q: What size system does my home need?
faqs.a: As a rule of thumb, 1 kW generates around 120 units per month. If your monthly bill is 300–400 units, a 3 kW system usually covers most of it. Our free site survey sizes the system precisely to your consumption and roof area — you need roughly 80–100 sq ft of shadow-free roof per kW.

faqs.q: How does net metering work?
faqs.a: A bidirectional meter records both the power you draw from the grid and the surplus solar power you export. At billing time, exports are credited against imports, so you pay only for the net units consumed. We handle the complete net-metering application with your DISCOM.

faqs.q: Does Saatvik handle the PM Surya Ghar application?
faqs.a: Yes. As a registered vendor, we prepare and file your application on the National Portal for Rooftop Solar, coordinate the DISCOM inspection, and ensure the subsidy is credited directly to your bank account after commissioning.

faqs.q: How much maintenance does a rooftop system need?
faqs.a: Very little — periodic panel cleaning and an annual health check. There are no moving parts. Saatvik modules carry a 12-year product and 25-year performance warranty, and our service network supports you throughout.

The Film
Built for PID-Free Bifacial Modules
Saatvik SS-EPE UVT-F and SS-EPE UVC-B are highly transparent encapsulant films with excellent weather resistance, strong adhesion to glass and metal materials, and outstanding operational performance. These films enable shorter lamination cycles while maintaining high module efficiency.
The EPE-series provides a highly cost-effective encapsulant solution for PID-free requirements in both P-type and N-type bifacial PV modules. It can successfully withstand a 288-hour PID test under test conditions of 85°C, 85% RH, and 1500 VDC. In addition, EPE-series films exhibit excellent long-term durability and reliability.

Excellent long-term resistance against PID (Potential Induced Degradation).

faqs.q: What is the Uday Series?
faqs.a: Uday is Saatvik's family of on-grid (grid-tie) string solar inverters, ranging from 1.1 kW single-phase units for homes to 50 kW three-phase inverters for commercial and industrial plants.

faqs.q: How efficient are Saatvik inverters?
faqs.a: The Uday Series delivers over 98.7% peak efficiency, so more of the DC power your solar array generates is converted into usable AC energy — improving payback and lifetime yield.

faqs.q: Can I monitor my inverter remotely?
faqs.a: Yes. Uday inverters support Wi-Fi, RS485 and Ethernet connectivity, letting you track generation, performance and faults in real time from a smartphone or computer.

faqs.q: Are Uday inverters suited to Indian grid conditions?
faqs.a: Every unit includes advanced grid-support functions — reactive-power compensation, low-voltage ride-through and anti-islanding — and is certified to IEC 62109 for safe, code-compliant operation.

faqs.q: What protection and warranty do they carry?
faqs.a: Uday inverters are rated IP65 with anti-PID protection for harsh outdoor environments, and the range is backed by a standard 10-year warranty.

About Melcon
Reliable Power & Distribution Transformers
MELCON is an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified organisation, recognised as a pioneer in the manufacturing and export of reliable power and distribution transformers up to 25 MVA, 33 kV voltage class. As a Saatvik Group company, each transformer is meticulously designed to meet diverse industrial requirements — ensuring superior quality, performance and reliability.
Part of Saatvik
Saatvik Green Energy Limited has acquired an 80% stake in Melcon Transformers — marking its entry into transmission-equipment manufacturing and strengthening its position as an integrated energy-solutions provider.
More About Us
Our Range
Engineered solutions across specialised categories
Oil-Immersed Transformers
Core and windings submerged in dielectric oil for superior heat dissipation. From 5 kVA to 25,000 kVA, up to 33 kV class — ONAN/ONAF cooled, IS 1180 / IS 2026 / IEC 76 compliant.
Learn More
Dry-Type Transformers (VPI)
Air-cooled, epoxy/cast-resin insulation via vacuum pressure impregnation. Up to 2,500 kVA, Class F/H — self-extinguishing and ideal for indoor and fire-sensitive environments.
Energy-Efficient Distribution
Star-rated, low-loss distribution transformers that minimise no-load and load losses across their operating life — reducing energy waste and total cost of ownership.
Special-Designed Transformers
Scott-T, heat-tracing, converter-duty, hermetically-sealed, furnace, ultra-isolation and low-harmonics units — plus solar-duty transformers and monitoring accessories & panels.
Industries We Serve
Powering a wide spectrum of industries
From renewable generation to heavy industry, MELCON transformers keep power flowing across the sectors that build the economy.

Melcon, a Saatvik Group company, has built a reputation for durable, energy-efficient power & distribution transformers — customised to requirement, and backed by responsive after-sales service.
About Melcon
MELCON is an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified organisation, recognised as a pioneer in the manufacturing and export of reliable power and distribution transformers up to 25 MVA, 33 kV voltage class. Each product is meticulously designed to meet diverse industrial requirements — ensuring superior quality, performance and reliability.
Part of Saatvik
Saatvik Green Energy Limited has acquired an 80% stake in Melcon Transformers, marking its entry into transmission-equipment manufacturing and strengthening its position as an integrated energy-solutions provider.
Our Operation
We operate a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility at F-90, Matsya Industrial Area (MIA), Alwar, Rajasthan — within the National Capital Region (NCR) of New Delhi. This advanced facility enables MELCON to consistently deliver high-quality transformers to electricity boards, PSUs and private organisations across the globe.
Our Strength
ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 & ISO 45001:2018 certified

“To be a global leader in innovative power transmission & distribution solutions, built on professional and dependable service.”

Complete in-house plant & machinery for transformers up to 25 MVA, 33 kV — with calibrated equipment, 2 ovens and 1200 / 600 LPH oil-filtration machines.
Active Factory, Pollution and BIS licenses; ISI trademark and registered brand.

About Melcon MELCON is an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified organisation, recognised as a pioneer in the manufacturing and export of reliable power and distribution transformers up to 25 MVA, 33 kV voltage class . Each product is meticulously designed to meet diverse industrial requirements — ensuring superior quality, performance and reliability. Part of Saatvik Saatvik Green

sections.heading: Vision & Mission
sections.text: “To be a global leader in innovative power transmission & distribution solutions, built on professional and dependable service.” We commit to total customer satisfaction through quality products, timely delivery and a dedicated after-sales team — the foundation of our reputation for over two decades. Power & distribution transformers for every duty
From 5 kVA distribution units to 10 MVA power transformers, up to 37.5 kV class — oil-immersed, energy-efficient, special-purpose and dry-type, engineered to IS, IEC and international standards.
5 kVA to 25,000 kVA · up to 33 kV class
Oil-Immersed Transformers
The most widely deployed transformer type globally. The core and windings are submerged in dielectric oil that serves as both insulation and coolant, providing superior heat dissipation — with thermal conductivity around six times greater than air.
View Specifications
Up to 2,500 kVA · Class F/H · IS-11171
Dry-Type Transformers (VPI)
Dry-type transformers rely on air circulation and solid insulation such as epoxy or cast resin, using vacuum pressure impregnation (VPI). They eliminate all oil-related hazards, making them the preferred choice for indoor and fire-sensitive environments.
Low-loss, star-rated distribution
Energy-Efficient Distribution Transformers
Star-rated, low-loss distribution transformers engineered to minimise no-load and load losses across their operating life — reducing energy waste and total cost of ownership for utilities and industry.
Up to 25 MVA, 33 kV class
Power Transformers
Robust power transformers for transmission and heavy-industrial applications, manufactured up to 25 MVA and 33 kV class — designed to withstand short-circuit, impulse and dynamic tests to international standards.
Inverter-duty for solar plants
Solar-Duty Transformers
Solar-duty (inverter-duty) transformers built for the demanding waveform and cycling of solar generation — handling harmonics and fluctuating loads to step up inverter output for reliable grid integration.
Scott-T, furnace, converter-duty & more
Special-Designed Transformers
Purpose-engineered transformers for specialised applications — including Scott-T, heat-tracing, converter-duty, hermetically-sealed, self-filtration, green, furnace, ultra-isolation and low-harmonics designs, plus monitoring accessories and panels.

title: Solar PV Modules — Saatvik Green Energy
description: Explore Saatvik's range of high-efficiency solar PV modules. Mono PERC Monofacial, Mono PERC Bifacial, and N-TOPCon technology up to 640Wp.

faqs.q: What types of solar modules does Saatvik offer?
faqs.a: Saatvik manufactures three core module technologies: Mono PERC Monofacial panels (380–555 Wp) for standard installations, Mono PERC Bifacial panels (525–550 Wp) that capture light from both sides for higher yield, and next-generation N-TOPCon modules (up to 640 Wp) delivering best-in-class efficiency at up to 23.69%.

faqs.q: What is the maximum power output of Saatvik solar panels?
faqs.a: Our highest-output modules are the N-TOPCon series, reaching up to 640 Wp per panel with 23.69% module efficiency. This is achieved through N-Type TOPCon 182 mm half-cut cell technology in a 132-cell G12R configuration.

faqs.q: What is the warranty on Saatvik solar modules?
faqs.a: Saatvik offers a 12-year product warranty on Mono PERC and N-TOPCon modules. Performance warranties extend to 25 years for Mono PERC and 30 years for N-TOPCon, guaranteeing long-term energy output.

faqs.q: What is the difference between monofacial and bifacial solar panels?
faqs.a: Monofacial panels absorb sunlight from the front side only, while bifacial panels capture light from both the front and rear surfaces. Bifacial technology can deliver up to 30% more energy by harvesting reflected and diffuse light from the ground beneath the panels, making them ideal for ground-mounted and tracker systems.

faqs.q: Are Saatvik modules suitable for utility-scale solar farms?
faqs.a: Yes. Our N-TOPCon and Mono PERC Bifacial modules are specifically designed for utility-scale deployments. They are optimised for ground-mounted tracker systems with robust mechanical load tolerance, high bifacial gain of up to 30%, and industry-leading degradation rates that ensure reliable performance over 25–30 year project lifetimes.

title: N-TOPCon Module Technology — Saatvik Green Energy
description: Saatvik N-Type TOPCon solar technology — tunnel oxide passivated contact cells with up to 23.69% module efficiency, lower degradation, superior bifaciality and 30-year warranties across the TEJ and TEJ PLUS bifacial ranges.
headings: Ready To Switch To Solar With Saatvik?

faqs.q: What is N-Type TOPCon technology?
faqs.a: TOPCon (Tunnel Oxide Passivated Contact) cells add an ultra-thin tunnel oxide layer and polysilicon film to an N-type silicon wafer. This passivation minimises electron recombination, lifting average cell conversion efficiency to 25% and module efficiency to 23.69% while improving thermal stability and longevity.

faqs.q: How is N-TOPCon better than Mono PERC?
faqs.a: Compared with Saatvik's Mono PERC modules, N-TOPCon delivers higher efficiency (up to 23.69% vs 21.48%), a better temperature coefficient (−0.30 vs −0.36 %/°C), lower degradation (under 0.40% vs 0.55% per year) and a longer 30-year performance warranty — with 10–30% more energy from bifacial gain.

faqs.q: Which N-TOPCon modules does Saatvik offer?
faqs.a: Two bifacial glass-to-glass ranges: TEJ BiFacial on the M10R wafer (560–585 Wp, up to 22.8% efficiency, 144 cells) and TEJ PLUS BiFacial on the larger G12R wafer (600–640 Wp, 132 cells, up to 23.69% efficiency). Both carry 12-year product and 30-year performance warranties.

faqs.q: Do N-TOPCon modules perform well in hot and low-light conditions?
faqs.a: Yes. The −0.30 %/°C power temperature coefficient limits hot-climate losses, and N-type cells maintain strong output in early morning, overcast and low-irradiance conditions — key advantages for Indian utility-scale and C&I sites.

faqs.q: Are these modules compatible with standard mounting and inverters?
faqs.a: Both TEJ ranges are designed for seamless, plug-and-play compatibility with standard racking systems, trackers and string or central inverters, with 1500 V DC system voltage and MC4-compatible connectors.

The Technology
Inside the TOPCon Cell
TOPCon (Tunnel Oxide Passivated Contact) solar cells integrate advanced passivation techniques to enhance energy conversion. An ultra-thin oxide layer forms a tunnel for electrons, minimising recombination and optimising power output — with exceptional thermal stability for consistent long-term performance.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is N-Type TOPCon technology?+
TOPCon (Tunnel Oxide Passivated Contact) cells add an ultra-thin tunnel oxide layer and polysilicon film to an N-type silicon wafer. This passivation minimises electron recombination, lifting average cell conversion efficiency to 25% and module efficiency to 23.69% while improving thermal stability and longevity.
How is N-TOPCon better than Mono PERC?+
Compared with Saatvik's Mono PERC modules, N-TOPCon delivers higher efficiency (up to 23.69% vs 21.48%), a better temperature coefficient (−0.30 vs −0.36 %/°C), lower degradation (under 0.40% vs 0.55% per year) and a longer 30-year performance warranty — with 10–30% more energy from bifacial gain.
Which N-TOPCon modules does Saatvik offer?+
Two bifacial glass-to-glass ranges: TEJ BiFacial on the M10R wafer (560–585 Wp, up to 22.8% efficiency, 144 cells) and TEJ PLUS BiFacial on the larger G12R wafer (600–640 Wp, 132 cells, up to 23.69% efficiency). Both carry 12-year product and 30-year performance warranties.
Do N-TOPCon modules perform well in hot and low-light conditions?+
Yes. The −0.30 %/°C power temperature coefficient limits hot-climate losses, and N-type cells maintain strong output in early morning, overcast and low-irradiance conditions — key advantages for Indian utility-scale and C&I sites.
Are these modules compatible with standard mounting and inverters?+
Both TEJ ranges are designed for seamless, plug-and-play compatibility with standard racking systems, trackers and string or central inverters, with 1500 V DC system voltage and MC4-compatible connectors.

A Guide To Clean Solar Panels: Everything You Should Know For Optimal Performance
All Blogs
Are you one of those people who made the switch to clean solar energy? If yes, you already made the smart choice for both your wallet and the future. However, do you know that having a solar system installed is not enough; being regular to clean solar panels is also a must. A little care is needed for your rooftop solar system to run smoothly and to impart maximum efficiency.
Rooftop solar panel cleaning is often overlooked, which can lead to the entire solar panel system becoming inefficient. Thus, in this write-up, given all the necessary details like how to clean solar panels, when to clean, etc. Read it till the end so that you can know all about solar panel cleaning.
Why Should You Clean Solar Panels?
Regular solar panel cleaning is key to ensuring that your rooftop solar system runs perfectly. By keeping it clean and intact, you ensure that you’ll receive maximum output from it. Another major reason to clean solar panels often is to detect potential issues earlier. It’ll save you from spending more later and let you enjoy better ROI during the entire solar lifespan.
How Can You Know About The Time To Clean Solar Panels?
If you can look at your rooftop solar system from the ground, simply look for dirt, dust, debris, bird droppings, or any kind of piled-up grime.
If you can’t look at it, monitor the output if there is any drop; it is a clear indication for you to clean the solar panels.
How Often Do You Need To Clean Solar Panels?
The primary question that you need to ask yourself is how often it is needed to clean solar panels. The general rule says to do rooftop solar panel cleaning at least thrice in a month. But it completely depends on the place and environment you are residing in.
For instance,
Rainy Areas
If you live in a place that gets regular rainfall, you don’t need to clean solar panels as often. Just clean the module with the cloth mop after the rain stops.
Dusty Regions
Living in an urban or industrial area or maybe a place with high pollution, you need to clean your rooftop solar system often, at least once in a week. If you are in a rural or farmland kind of place, the dust from there can get accumulated, making it a mandate to clean solar panels.
Places with Lots of Trees
If your home is in a place with lots of trees, chances are higher that you might find leaves, branches, and bird droppings collecting on your panels. In that case, you need to clean solar panels more regularly, mainly in the summer or spring.
Ways To Clean Solar Panels: A Detailed Explanation
There are various ways to clean solar panels, ranging from conventional manual cleaning to fully automated techniques. Let’s move ahead to know about each of these practices.
1. Automatic Robotic Cleaning
Next-gen technology makes it possible to manufacture automatic and semi-automatic robots specifically designed to clean solar panels. Portable semi-automatic robots are available in the market that can easily do rooftop solar panel cleaning on carports, shed roofs, greenhouses, etc. Besides this, fixed roof robots are also available in the markets ideal for solar panel cleaning at a large-scale solar system that requires regular cleaning.
2. Vibrational Cleaning
Under this technique, there is a way to employ sonic vibrations to dislodge accumulated dirt or dust. It all becomes possible with a DC motor mounted behind the panels that can be adjusted to induce vertical vibration. It can really save a lot of water and is highly effective when it comes to cleaning solar panels. On the other hand, it is quite limited and costly as well.
Though it is not recommended by some of the reputed solar companies to use it as it can broke the module glass. In case of using it, ensure the frequency level is of low vibration, i.e., 20-50 Hz, and the amplitude level should be between 0.5 and 2 mm.
3. Manual (Conventional Way) Cleaning
Cleaning solar panels manually is the old, traditional, and conventional way. All the above ways of rooftop solar panel cleaning are indeed efficient and effective, but there are many scenarios where these techniques have proved to be very expensive and inefficient. Manual solar panels cleaning is an ideal solution for smaller solar installations of residential or commercial scale.
As you are ready to do the task on your own, it is essential for you to clean solar panels safely, maybe in the early morning or evening when the panels are cool. Here are the tools that you need for rooftop solar panel cleaning at your place.
A mild non-acidic cleaning solution for cleaning PV solar modules
Low-pressure water hose
Neutral water (pH: 6.5 to 7.5)
Hand Wiper
Soft brush, cotton mop, or soft sponge for the panel surface
Gloves
Steady ladder
PPE for enhanced safety
Steps to Clean Solar Panels at your Home
Here is a step-by-step guide to cleaning solar panels at home on your own.
First Step
Firstly, always remember to switch off the power to eliminate any kind of danger as a precautionary step.
Second Step
Wipe the surface of the panels with a dry mop. It ensures that no dust sticks to the panels after you pour the water on them.
Third Step
Hose off all the dry leaves, bird droppings, etc., at a low pressure.
Fourth Step
Dip your sponge in the normal water and softly wipe the surface. Don’t scrub harshly, as it can damage the cell or ARC coating of the panel entirely.
Fifth Step
Let the module dry off slowly. As the water will go away because of the inclination, wipe off any of the remnants to prevent stains or water loggings.
Once it all done to clean solar panels, let your panels dry. If there is humid or rainy weather, use a soft dry cloth to mop the panels. And now sit back and enjoy the benefits of solar energy.
Do’s And Don’ts Regarding Solar Panel Cleaning At Home Yourself
Here is a clear breakdown of the do’s and don’ts that you need to take into consideration to clean solar panels by yourself.
Things to do to clean solar panels
Things not to do while cleaning solar panels
Take a long-handle and nylon-bristle brush to clean every corner and nook of the panels.
Avoid climbing or stepping on the solar panels to clean them.
Either use RO or low-mineral based water of a pH level of 6.5 to 7.5 at a low pressure to clean solar panels.
Prevent the usage of sprinklers for rooftop solar panel cleaning to avoid partial shadow on the panels.
Always turn off the power supply before solar system cleaning.
Avoid solar panel cleaning when the solar modules are too hot.
Take non-acidic and mild cleaning solutions into usage for cleaning, which are ideal for solar panels cleaning.
Do not use abrasive tools and oil-contaminated cloths or a mop to wipe off dirt, dust, and bird droppings while cleaning the solar panels. And prevent the usage of any unspecified module cleaning solvents.
When to call a professional to clean solar panels?
It is alright to say that rooftop solar panels cleaning can be done by oneself, but there are times to call a professional for the same, which seems like the right choice. Here’s the scenario when to call them.
When you can’t clean solar panels
If you can’t reach the solar system, as it is installed on a steep roof, it’s better to leave the job to the professionals.
When you didn’t check on your solar system in a while
Even if your system seems to be working well, it’s good to have a professional inspection at least in even 6 months. A technician will come and clean everything or look for all other components as well.
When there is a drop in efficiency
If you are witnessing low output, you should look out for professional help to clean solar panels.
Final Note
It is imperative to clean solar panels regularly to maintain them for maximum efficiency and longer lifespan. If needed, don’t hesitate to call for some professional help. Be careful while cleaning rooftop solar panels, as you need to follow all the instructions and precautions mentioned above. Otherwise, you can damage the solar panel or cell, which can ultimately reduce your efficiency.
By staying proactive with maintenance and cleaning of solar panels, you can effortlessly continue to leverage the environmental and financial benefits of solar energy without facing any interruptions.
FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)
1. How do I know that it’s time for me to clean solar panels?
If you are experiencing a drop in your energy output or see dust, dirt, debris, or bird droppings on your solar panels, it’s time for cleaning. Dust storms, high pollen levels, or various other environmental factors also indicates to clean solar panels even if the efficiency remains the same.
2. What is the best thing to use to clean solar panels?
A soft mop or a dry sponge is always ideal for cleaning rooftop solar panels cleaning. Currently, things like brushes and mops for the same are available in the market. With a long handle and dual-head brushes, it becomes easier for you to clean solar panels.
3. Does rain clean solar panels?
Rain particularly wipes off all the loose dirt, but it can’t remove stuck grime, bird droppings, or debris. It can also leave mineral deposits on your panels or streaks that can cut down the level of efficiency. It is true that it helps when it comes to clean solar panels, but professional cleaning is a must for maximum efficiency.
4. Can I use bleach to clean solar panels?
It is advisable to avoid using bleach or any harsh chemicals, as these can damage the solar ARC coating on the glass and reduce efficiency. So, always opt for mild, eco-friendly, or specified module solutions for optimum results.
5. Is it safe to use a sprinkler for rooftop solar panel cleaning?
Certainly, it is safe to use a sprinkler to clean solar panels, but it shouldn’t cast any shadow on the panels. And after cleaning, cloth wiping is a must to clean any sticky dust particles. And if the sprinklers are placed on the top of the panels, it can cast shadows on the panels, leading to a reduction in efficiency and eventually leading to the formation of hotspots.

text:
EPCJan 19, 2026·7 min read
Beyond Land: The Potential of Floating Solar EPC Solutions
All Blogs
India is moving ahead, and as it grows, so does the electricity demand. To tackle this, attain net-zero emissions by 2070, and meet climate goals, Solar stands as a pivotal solution.
But here comes another challenge: India doesn’t have enough land to support this. Every 1 GW of solar plant requires around 4-5 square km of land, which is not possible in India. Hence, in this picture, Floating Solar EPC solutions emerge as the right fit and are gaining attention in India. It gives you maximum performance while using none of the land, and besides this, it conserves our water bodies as well.
Let’s dive into this a bit deeper to understand floating solar. Go through this article as it delves into the technology, benefits, and challenges of floating solar solutions.
A Short Brief of Floating Solar EPC Solutions
The concept is quite simple. Instead of fixing solar panels into the ground, you mount them on a buoyant platform and leave them on water to float with an anchor system. The solar panels are connected with inverter and an electrical structure on the shore through mooring systems, keeping everything in place. The electricity produced from the solar panels is fed into the grid by the underwater submarine cables.
Primary Components Included in Our Floating Solar EPC Solutions
To understand floating solar better and make the right choice timely, look at the components included in an entire floating solar farm.
Floating Platforms
It is a major part of a floating solar setup made of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) to support panels floating on the surface. Designed to resist corrosion and UV radiation, these platforms can easily tackle the harsh water conditions.
Solar Panels
Convert sunlight into electricity. In the case of floating solar, Panels are coated with a protective layer to secure the same from moisture and humidity.
Mounting Systems
Corrosion-resistant metals are used to attach panels to platforms. These are adjustable to place panels at the right angles for optimal performance and to withstand the movement of water.
Anchoring & Mooring Systems
Anchors, including concrete blocks or helical anchors and mooring lines like cables, chains, etc places the entire structure intact. The selection of both anchoring and mooring systems depends completely on depth, water body, and local environmental conditions.
Electrical Infrastructures
1. Inverters
Choose any from on-grid, central, and string depending on the size of the installation. It converts the panels’ produced DC into AC for the grid or local consumption.
2. Transformers
Infused to step up or step down the voltage of electricity to match the level of the grid or for a storage system.
3. Junction Boxes & Connectors
Securely conjoin everything and distribute the electrical output from various solar panels and inverters.
4. Underwater Cables
Submarine water cables added to transmit electricity from floating platforms to the shore placed system.
5. Monitoring & control systems
Under this comes sensors, data loggers, etc to keep trace of the performance of the solar panels. It provides real-time data, making efficient management and maintenance possible.
Safety & Environmental Protection Equipment
1. Safety Gear
Life jackets, harnesses, and protective clothing comes under this for the safety of the personnel performing installation and maintenance tasks on the water.
2. Environmental Protection Systems
Boom barriers and spill containment equipment to save the surrounding water from any possible contamination during installation.
Benefits of Adopting Our Floating Solar EPC Solutions
Certain advantages will come to you by choosing floating solar for your water bodies, capturing your precious lands. Look and read what those are:
Higher Energy Generation
When placed at a cooler temperature, solar PV panels perform better. The ambient temperature of the water bodies leads to more than 5-10% yield compared to land or ground mounted. With this, you can feed more clean energy to the grid.
Reduces Water Evaporation
The floating EPC solution will cover the area of water that limits the water from evaporating. It is an ideal scenario for all the water-stressed regions where people feel the scarcity of water.
Save Land for Other Purposes
India has limited land availability that is needed for other purposes like infrastructure, agriculture, education, employment, etc. Using it for solar makes no sense. Thus, choosing floating solar EPC here frees that land for other productive usage. In contrary, water bodies are already unusable for any other purpose.
Minimal Ecological Degradation
Floating solar farms have a little adverse effect on environmental conditions in comparison to conventional hydropower dams and reservoirs. It saves water from getting toxic and from growing algae. Moreover, placing floating solar panels leaves a scope for fish and other marine species to have a life over there.
Ease of Deployment
For floating solar EPC solutions, there is no need to perform any major earthwork, cutting the cost and disruption of site preparation.
Floating Solar Solutions: The Challenges Under The Surface
The path to a successful Floating Solar farm isn’t as smooth as it looks. It laid down a series of challenges. These are listed over here:
Surged Upfront Costs
If you are going ahead with a floating solar EPC solution, you need to spend 7-10% more in comparison to ground-mounted. It’s all because of the floating platforms that mainly took around 35% percent of the total floating solar project cost.
Social Impacts
Some of the massive floating solar projects hamper the livelihood of the fishermen. For generations, these people rely on fishing, but can’t access it now.
Apt Skill Shortage
Installing floating solar EPC solutions requires expertise in marine engineering, hydraulics, and float manufacturing, which are still minimally available in India.
Data Gaps
Many of the solar floating farm installations failed or get dropped because of not vividly checked for solar potential, leading to disturb the design and impact assessment.
Floating Solar EPC Solutions: Current Scenario in India
India, as a rich country have a total of 18,000 km2 showcasing a huge potential for floating solar systems installation with an approx. capacity of 280 GW. But only a fraction has been achieved till now. The nation is supporting this through renewable policy, mainly by the Solar Parks Scheme with CFA (Central financial assistance). Several states like Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, Telangana, West Bengal, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, and Rajasthan have already made significant steps in this.
Glimpse of Major Floating Solar Project (Ongoing & Planned)
Omkareshwar Floating Solar Project (Madhya Pradesh)
India’s largest floating solar plant with 600 MW, with over 2,00,000 high-performing panels and the world’s largest inverter-fused system. It produces 204,580 MWh annually while reducing 173,893 tonnes of CO₂ emissions, and conserve around 32.5 million tonnes cubic meters of water.
Ramagundam, Telangana
This is another project in India commissioned by NTPC limited with a 100 MW capacity, saving land and conserving water from evaporation. It comprises 40 blocks, each with 2.5 MW capacity, using 11,200 solar modules per block. It generates 223,000 MWh electricity by offsetting 210,000 CO₂ annually.
Kayamkulam, Kerala
Another notable project by NTPC has a capacity of around 92 MW.
Simhadri, Andhra Pradesh
It is a 25 MW of floating solar project by NTPC again, located on the Simhadri reservoir.
Greater Vishakhapatnam Smart City
This project is operational and working full-fledged, situated on the Mudasarlova reservoir, and has a capacity of 2 MW. It is developed by Greater Vishakhapatnam Smart City Corporation Limited (GVSCCL) as a part of the Smart Cities Mission.
In addition to all such projects, SECI (Solar Energy Corporation in India) and other state agencies are actively pushing for more projects in floating solar.
Ending Note: Powering The Future With Water
All in all, floating solar EPC solutions are an innovative and promising renewable energy solution. It has a dual impact, i.e., production of clean energy and water conservation, as well as turning to be an ideal solution in today’s climate-sensitive environment. Floating solar undoubtedly can become a vital part of our future, but only when get implemented with foresight, planning, and precision.
Take a step forward with the nation to make this world a greener place. It’s time to act and to turn your still water bodies into a power source that can power your house and livelihoods while saving nature. Look beyond and start using your vast water bodies with Solar EPC Company like Saatvik Green Energy Limited.

India’s commercial sector is rapidly shifting towards clean solar energy. Getting commercial solar panels installed at their places gives them an upper hand, with benefits like lower electricity costs, uninterrupted power, and the fulfilment of sustainability goals. From mega factories and warehouses to malls and educational institutions, commercial solar systems are gaining traction as they are confirmed to be long-term savings assets.
However, one questions always remains with people i.e., which one are the best commercial solar panels to use? For this and to bring more clarity, here is a detailed write-up here that can make you reach the point to take the best possible decision.
Commercial Solar Panels System: A Brief Explanation
In comparison to residential installations, commercial solar panel installations are mainly larger setups, designed to fulfil higher and more demanding energy needs.
Several industries are adopting solar panels for their commercial buildings. These are listed here:
Healthcare & hospitals
Pharmaceuticals
Automotive and ancillary units
Industrial and manufacturing
Hospitality
Education & research institutions
Fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG)
IT parks and commercial complexes
Basic Components Involved in Commercial Solar Panels Setup
A complete setup of commercial solar panels includes several components. These are:
1. Solar PV Modules
Solar panels for commercial buildings are mounted on the rooftop or the ground. Each panel relates to each other to form a setup that will produce solar energy.
2. Solar Inverters
Inverters are the crucial aspect of commercial solar systems as it converts DC electricity into alternating current (AC), which is needed for the commercial equipment to work.
Common inverters that are mostly used in commercial solar for businesses are:
3. Racking & Mounting Structure
Racking and mounting systems are designed to keep the panels intact with the rooftop and the ground. These are useful to:
Maintain the structural stability
Set the apt tilt and orientation
Accommodate site-specific conditions
4. Solar Batteries (Optional)
Batteries with commercial solar panels help in storing excess energy generated to use during the non-generation period or at the time of grid disturbances.
Battery technologies mainly include lithium-ion, lead-acid, or other chemistries based on the applications.
5. Charge Controllers & Meters
Charge controllers in commercial solar systems take care of the energy flow between panels and batteries. On the other hand, meters and monitoring systems track the generation, consumption, and grid interaction.
Cell Technology Comparison for Commercial Solar Panels Installation
The commercial solar panels market will be shaped by four of the cell technologies, i.e., NTOPCon, HJT, PERC, and thin film. Each cell type has its own unique efficiency profile, degradation curve, temperature behaviour, and cost position.
For you all to make the best decision while looking for solar panels for commercial buildings, here is a detailed comparison between these four cell technologies is given. So, kindly take a look before you reach out to the point to make your decision.

Factors To Choose Commercial Solar Panels for Your Business
Choosing the commercial solar panels only based on price can lead you to face several long-term performance related issues. Businesses must be smart here and should evaluate multiple factors.
1. Solar Panel Efficiency
Efficiency is the rate at which solar PV modules can convert sunlight into electricity.
Higher efficiency means:
Superior power generation

Why the Confusion Happens
If you’re planning to install a solar panel system at home, in your office, or at your factory, you’ve likely come across the terms solar module and solar panel.
While many people (and even vendors) use them interchangeably, there is a technical difference, and knowing this can help you:
Avoid confusion in quotes,
Understand solar PV module prices, and
Get better clarity from your EPC provider or solar panel manufacturer in India.
First, Understand the Basics of a Solar Panels System
Before we dive deeper, let’s break down the structure of a typical solar energy system:
1, Solar Cell
The smallest unit. A solar cell is a thin wafer made of semiconductor material. It converts sunlight into direct current (DC) electricity.
2, Solar Module
Multiple solar cells connected and placed within a frame form a solar pv module. This is what many people mistakenly refer to as a “panel.”
3, Solar Panel
Technically, a solar panel can consist of one or more solar modules. It’s a broader term often used to describe the visible part of the system mounted on your roof or site.
What’s the Difference Between a Solar Panel and a Solar Module?
Feature
Solar Module
Solar Panel
Definition
Single unit with multiple solar cells
May refer to one or more solar modules
Usage
Technical & manufacturing term
Commonly used in sales/marketing
Role in System
Core energy-producing unit
Often represents the entire installed unit
Clarity
Precise in technical use
Misleading if not clarified
Solar PV Module Price vs Solar Panel System Price: Why the Difference Matters
When comparing solar module prices or browsing online for the best solar panels in India, people often mix up two things:
The price of an individual module
The cost of a full solar panel system (which includes an inverter, wiring, mounting structure, and more)
A module might cost you ₹20–30 per watt, depending on quality, brand, and quantity.
A full 3kW rooftop solar system may cost ₹1.5–2 lakhs, depending on subsidies and installation type.
So it’s important to ask your EPC provider or solar panel manufacturer exactly what’s included.
Why This Knowledge is Crucial for Indian Buyers
In India, solar adoption is rising fast, but so is miscommunication and misinformation. Many local vendors give unclear pricing or mislead buyers who are unaware of terms like “module” or “panel.”
This often leads to:
Overpaying for a lower-output system
Wrong expectations from the installer
Substandard service post-installation
By understanding the correct structure of a solar panel system, you’ll be better equipped to ask the right questions and choose the best solar panel manufacturer in India.
Industry Tip: What Professionals Say
In the solar manufacturing and EPC world, professionals use “solar module” in technical specs like:
So when checking solar module prices, always look at:
Wattage per module
Number of modules included
Total capacity (in kW) for your needs
Final Summary: Are They the Same?
A solar module is a single-framed unit of solar cells.
A solar panel may refer to a module or a group of modules, depending on the context.
When comparing solar PV module prices or negotiating with solar panel manufacturers, always ask for clear details.

Do’s and Don’ts on Ground-mounted & Rooftop Solar Panel Installation
All Blogs
Is solar panel installation becoming a daunting task for you? Maybe because you are not considering the necessary guidelines. As a forerunner in solar manufacturing and rooftop solar panel installation in India, we saw everything good, bad, and the worst that can happen in panel installation.
Thus, witness all the do’s and don’ts for rooftop and ground-mounted installation that you must know. Keep these tips in mind for placing solar systems that can shine and perform for endless years.
Do’s and Don’ts – Ground-Mounted & Rooftop Solar Panels Installation
These are the things that you should necessarily do, and in contrast, those things that you shouldn’t do while proceeding with ground-mounted & rooftop solar panel installation.
Let’s start with Do’s regarding ground-mounted & rooftop solar panel installation.
Do’s For Ground-mounted & Rooftop Solar Panel Installation
1. Research before taking any step
The foremost thing to do is to accumulate all the possible information. Come in contact with the solar manufacturers & installers to get an idea of the entire process. It is better to be prepared instead of making silly mistakes in the future.
2. Evaluate the types of solar panels
Know about the solar panels beforehand, like which one to choose between MonoPerc or TOPCon, depending on factors like budget, availability, efficiency, and outcome.
3. Take care of the panel orientation or setup
Ideally, the solar panel must face south at a tilted angle in relation to your location’s latitude to maximize power generation.
4. Plan permissions and paperwork
Seek clarity on all the paperwork, like contracts, permits, and grid connection application papers, before you kick off the solar project.
5. Figure out your electrical connection in advance
Carefully and with full focus, form a layout of where you want wires, panels, and other components on your rooftop solar panel installation. Having a detailed map will help you tackle the complex last-minute alterations.
6. Ensure watertight roof penetration
Make use of high-quality casings and waterproof sealant when drilling spaces in your roof for wiring to prevent water leakages.
7. Perform Maintenance regularly
Make a habit of conducting bi-solar plant inspections to trace down the aging modules, wiring defects, and debris collection earlier. Maintain it properly for expanding the life span of the solar system.
8. Plan drainage for ground-mounted solar systems
Take a step to secure the areas from waterlogging or erosion by offering necessary site leveling and drainage systems around the solar system.
9. Take measures against theft
Install anti-theft bolts, fencing, and CCTV in remote areas or the nearby areas of the ground-mounted and rooftop solar panel installation to keep it safe from theft and tampering.
10. Use high-quality mounting structures
Always use galvanized or aluminium structures that can fight back corrosion, weather, and rust, leading to the system’s long life and high reliability.
Don’ts For Rooftop & Ground-Mounted Solar Panel Installation
1. Don’t go with DIY (Do it yourself) installation
Unless and until you are a qualified electrician, solar installation needs to be left in the hands of professionals. Wrong installation can lead to minimal output or, worse, sometimes cause accidents.
2. Don’t neglect safety practices
Wear safety headgear and safety harnesses while working on rooftops, and power off the main line until the solar system starts.
3. Don’t block the panel’s exposure
Leave enough space for all future equipment like coolers, antennae, etc., and make sure that there will be ample space around panels for access and easy maintenance.
4. Don’t mix panel types or brands
Mixing or amalgaming of panels creates compatibility issues, mismatch losses, and lower efficiency, leading to full system imbalance.
5. Don’t assume one size fits everywhere
Every ground-mounted & rooftop solar panel installation site or need is unique, so don’t ever think one size fits everywhere. Generic designs can result in suboptimal generation.
6. Don’t forget to clean panels regularly
Dirt, dust, dew, and grime can cut down the efficiency level by up to 15-20%, lowering the total energy yield.
7. Don’t use cheap or low-class material
Usage of inferior or third-class panels, cables, and other accessories leads to failures, safety risks, and long-term chaos.
8. Don’t ignore Long-term considerations
Plan for battery incorporation right from the beginning, even before your ground-mounted & rooftop solar panel installation. Leave suitable space for future additions or expansion of your solar system.
9. Don’t place panels too close
Less space or cluttered panel placement blocks the airflow, which in turn causes a rise in temperatures and a drop in efficiency.
10. Don’t be the expert
The solar system isn’t the same as the electrical connections, so don’t perform anything on your own, as it may cause trips, hindrances, and a downfall in power generation.
In a Nutshell
Ground-mounted & rooftop solar panel installation has become as easy as you can’t imagine, with some experts like Saatvik Solar. All the above-listed do’s and don’ts are something that you shouldn’t miss for a seamless process. Indeed, installing solar panels is not strenuous, but without ensuring all the needed measures, it turns out to be ominous for sure. Thus, follow these and make your panels live longer and improve their efficiency at par.
FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)
1. What needs to be done to make the panels securely attached to the roof?
Screws and bolts are the main components used to secure them at a specific place and then panels are attached to the hooks through clamps or brackets.
2. What should to inspected before proceeding to install solar panels?
The 6 main things that you should consider without any mistake are as follows:
Research on the installers and grid connection policies
Analyze your roof’s condition and orientation
Compare the various types of panels
Evaluate all the financing and payment alternatives
Get an idea of your current energy usage
Calculate your costs in comparison with savings
3. What documents do I need for solar panels installed?
To attain the subsidy or financing of the rooftop or ground-mounted solar system, you’ll mainly need documents like proof of identity and address, the last few months of electricity bills, and proof of property ownership.
Moreover, if you are applying for the subsidy under PM Surya Ghar, you need to have bank account details, and possibly income proof or a family ration card.
