Dry Type Transformer V/S Oil Type Transformer.
All Blogs
Ensuring a consistent, efficient, and uninterrupted power supply across infrastructure, industries, and commodities is crucial, and oil type transformers and dry type transformers play important roles in this regard. Transformers are the backbone of efficient and dependable power transmission, supported by cutting-edge technology from generation to consumption.
Both types of transformers include a cooling medium. Oil-type transformers utilize mineral oil or silicone liquid, whilst dry-type transformers use natural or forced air. Oil type transformers require external space for installation, however dry type transformers may be put on-site and are ideally suited for use in malls, hospitals, major institutions, and high-rise residences near load areas.
Oil type transformers have a higher efficiency and can handle massive power ratings and voltages up to and above 20MVA, whereas dry type transformers are specifically designed for low energy capacities and voltages up to 35 KVA. Maintenance for oil type transformers requires routine oil testing and filtration, whereas dry type transformers require very little maintenance, primarily cleaning dust from windings. Oil type transformers have a longer lifespan and are thought to be more cost effective solutions for large-scale operations, whereas dry type transformers have a shorter lifespan, a higher initial purchase price, and are thought to be appropriate for smaller operations across defined units and locations.
In terms of safety, oil type transformers are more prone to oil leaks and flammability and should be installed atop containment structures, whereas dry type transformers are non-flammable and emit no harmful spills or fumes.
Which transformer to be chosen: –
If power demand is high, combined with greater power ratings, and the unit needs to be put in an outbuilding, oil type transformers are the ideal option since they may provide extremely adequate and long-lasting solutions. And if the requirements are in tight interior locations for commercial use to meet daily power needs where fire protection and environmental safety are top priority, dry type transformers are the best option.
Woking matrix of Oil type and Dry type transformers: –
Oil-type transformers use electromagnetic induction to alter electrical voltage, with the core and windings entirely submerged in transformer oil, which serves as both a strong electrical insulator and a liquid coolant to keep the device protected from overheating during significant energy transfer. Where in as a dry type transformer changes electrical energy between circuits without direct physical contact. Instead of using cooling and insulation liquids dry type transformers uses solid insulation such as epoxy resin and air. For dry type transformer working mechanism is totally depends on primary excitation, magnetic flux linkage and Voltage induction.
To make it more safer heat generated during the induction process, must be safely dissipated, core benefits of these transformers are they are highly eco-friendly, pose zero fire risk and are idea electrical transformers for indoor applications.
Application of Dry type and oil type transformers
Dry type transformers are widely used across various industries and applications that are concerned about safety, reliability and environmental compatibility hence are best suited for chemical, oil and gas industry supplying power to various equipment and processes that involve flammable or explosive substances. Environmental sensitive areas are also equipped with dry type transformers that are used to protect the environment from oil spills and leakage resulting contamination of water sources, soil or natural habits especially in forests and wetlands.
If concern is related to the fire where defined zones falls under the high fire risk category dry type transformers play the most crucial and important role preventing fire hazards or minimize fire damages in areas that are prone to fire outbreaks or have strict fire regulations.
Oil type transformer application vary totally in a different state where in key application matrix primarily depends on the power generation and transmission usage especially for long distance connectivity power transmission, where in as substations are installed to reduce voltages for commercial and residential usage. Oil type transformers are best suited for heavy industries and machineries manufacturing firms as their supply requirements are continuous and demands heavy duty power for smother operational activities. Major renewable energy projects are too accompanied with oil type transformers especially solar and wind projects to efficiently handle fluctuating power loads and step up the energy generated for grid integration.

TransformersOct 01, 2026·3 min read
Future of Transformers in Oil, Gas and Infrastructure Industries
All Blogs
The Indian economy is increasing its clean energy resources and speeding the use of renewable energy. Major sectors such as oil, gas, and infrastructure are among the largest consumers of electrical power and are increasingly shifting to renewable energy to meet their demands. As the sectors migrate to digital, sustainable, and smarter energy systems, power distribution transformers play an increasingly important role. Transformers will change the oil and gas sector as futuristic and sophisticated technologies are integrated across the power industry, with an emphasis on SCADA-ready, smart energy efficient, and environmentally friendly designs that meet increased energy needs and safety standards.
The Role Transformers Are Playing in These Industries Today
Transformers today in the oil and gas industry ensure stable power supply for drilling equipment, refinery operations, pumping stations etc. These operational activities require continuous and uninterrupted power with high reliability to ensure overall operational efficiency. Transformers help regulate and distribute electrical power efficiently.
In the infrastructure industry, transformers are regarded as the foundation of power supply requirements and grid connection. From large-scale infrastructure projects and commercial development to transit networks, data centres, utilities, and urban planning. Transformers used in these sectors must tolerate severe temperatures, large voltage swings, and heavy loads while maintaining uninterrupted operation. With oil type distribution transformers becoming the lifeline for these industries, even small disruptions or technical faults can result in significant delays and financial losses. For such organisations, power failure also results in losses in productivity, dependability and, to an extent, safety concerns as well.
Challenges Faced by These Industries Using Traditional Transformers
Although traditional transformers have served these industries for decades, a shift towards adopting modern and high technology is now important, as traditional transformers come with limitations — modernization is necessary for staying updated in the tech environment. Conventional or traditional transformers have limited control over real-time monitoring, making fault detection slow and reactive. High load fluctuations and ageing design in traditional transformers lead to greater energy losses and impact the overall efficiency of the transformer. Traditional or conventional transformers have certain environmental concerns as well, such as the use of mineral oils, which can pose environmental risks in case of leakage or spillage. Frequent manual inspections and reactive repairs always increase the overall maintenance cost. With traditional transformers' applications and usages in these industries, experts have reviewed the challenges identified above.
With these obstacles in place, a transition to a wiser period is essential, with the future focusing on SCADA-ready transformers. These gadgets not only provide energy, but also function as an intelligent node in the oil and gas sector. Industries are demanding transformers that are future-ready, with features like IoT interfaces, self-diagnostics, environmentally friendly fluids, cybersecurity, and so on. The integration of SCADA in the oil and gas industry will undoubtedly provide real-time insights and improve overall performance, allowing engineers to remotely monitor transformer health, detect faults before they escalate, balance loads across multiple substations, and optimise power consumption at pumping stations.
Benefits of Smart Transformers for Oil and Gas
Future-ready smart application-enabled transformers offer operational and financial advantages including less downtime, improved safety, cheaper operating and maintenance costs, energy optimisation, and, most importantly, less environmental effect due to their eco-friendly design. Future-focused technological advancements target the infrastructure, oil, and gas industries. These sectors are likewise moving toward hybrid transformers that can handle both oil distribution and renewable energy connections.
Conclusion
Seeking the trend and transition toward futuristic technological trends, the conversion of industries to smart and digitalisation will undoubtedly be the next move. Industries will adopt smart electric transformers to meet their power needs. This is where smart transformers are expected to play a distinguishing role. Smart transformers, which are equipped with enhanced monitoring, sensors, remote diagnostics, and digital connection, may assist companies in monitoring vital parameters, identifying possible faults early on, optimising power performance, and supporting predictive maintenance. For industries where even a brief power outage may have a significant impact on productivity, safety, and operational continuity, this knowledge can be a vital advantage.

text:
Rooftop SolarAug 04, 2026·5 min read
How Rooftop Solar Pays for Itself in Under 5 Years
All Blogs
Solar isn't just good for the planet — for most Indian homeowners it's one of the safest investments available, quietly paying you back every single month. The real question isn't whether a rooftop system pays for itself, but how fast. For a typical home, the answer is usually under five years. Here's the full math.
Our example: a typical 3 kW home
Let's take a realistic middle-class household:
Monthly electricity use: ~400 units (kWh)
Average tariff: ₹8 per unit (most urban domestic slabs run ₹7–₹9)
Rooftop space: enough for a 3 kW grid-tied system (~200 sq ft)
A 3 kW on-grid system is the sweet spot for a home consuming around 350–450 units a month.
Step 1 — What it costs
A good-quality 3 kW rooftop system — high-efficiency modules, a reliable on-grid inverter, mounting structure, wiring and installation — costs roughly ₹1,80,000 (about ₹60,000 per kW).
Under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, the central subsidy is ₹30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW:
2 kW × ₹30,000 = ₹60,000
1 kW × ₹18,000 = ₹18,000
Total subsidy = ₹78,000
So your net out-of-pocket cost is ₹1,80,000 − ₹78,000 = ₹1,02,000.
Step 2 — What it generates & saves
Across most of India a rooftop system produces about 4.2 units per kW per day. For 3 kW:
3 kW × 4.2 units × 30 days ≈ 378 units per month
That covers almost all of a 400-unit bill. With net metering, any surplus you export by day is credited against the units you draw at night. At ₹8 per unit:
378 units × ₹8 = ₹3,024 saved every month
≈ ₹36,300 per year
Step 3 — The payback
Now divide the net cost by the annual saving:
₹1,02,000 ÷ ₹36,300 ≈ 2.8 years.
Even on conservative assumptions — a higher system cost, lower generation in a cloudier region, a ₹7 tariff — payback still typically lands between 3 and 5 years.
What makes it faster (or slower)
Your tariff: the higher your per-unit rate, the faster solar pays back. Commercial and higher domestic slabs see paybacks closer to 3 years.
Sunlight: Rajasthan, Gujarat and central India generate more per kW than the far north-east.
System quality: higher-efficiency N-TOPCon modules and a high-conversion inverter pull more units from the same roof — and hold that output for longer.
Self-consumption: running heavy loads during daylight (pumps, ACs, washing) uses solar directly and maximises savings.
After payback: 20+ years of near-free power
Here's what makes solar a genuine asset. Quality panels carry a 25–30 year performance warranty. Once the system has paid for itself in ~3–5 years, everything it generates for the next two decades is essentially free electricity — shielding you from every future tariff hike.
Over a 25-year life, a 3 kW system saving ₹36,000 a year returns well over ₹9 lakh in avoided bills (and more as tariffs climb), against a net cost of about ₹1 lakh.
The bottom line
For a typical Indian home, rooftop solar pays for itself in under five years — often under three — and then keeps paying for 20+ years more. With the PM Surya Ghar subsidy and net metering, there has never been a better time to switch.

How to Choose the Best Solar Panel for Home in India?

As the world is slowly tilting towards renewable energy, solar power is starting to become the priority for every homeowner. Nowadays, the electricity rates are rising day by day, and the environment is getting filled up with too many concerns. So, investing in solar panels is a great decision. So, the question here is: Are you smart enough to make the shift? If yes, you should begin to look for the best solar panels for home. Another roadblock is here: How?
In this informative blog, you’ll find all the answers you need to have about the best solar panels for home use. Walk through all the info and guidelines highlighted here to land the right decision for your home.
Behind the Scenes: How Best Solar Panels for Home Work?
Before you proceed to settle on the best solar panels for home in India, it’s essential to understand how they work. So, witness how it works, and how it can be a great alternative for your home instead of the traditional electricity method.
Photon Absorption
Sunlight is all about rays filled with tiny particles called photons. The panels consist of a plethora of silicon photovoltaic cells. When sunlight falls, these cells begin to absorb photons.
Electron Reaction
When the photons get absorbed, they start to transfer or shift their energy to the electrons residing in the silicon atoms of the solar cells. This act of energy absorption excites the atom to become free from its electrons by breaking all the bonds.
Electric Field Generation
The entire structure of the best solar panels for home use in India contains an electric field across the layers of silicon. The whole process begins with this field as it forces all the loose electrons to flow in a specific direction, forming a flow for electricity.
Electrical Conductors
Now comes the part of conductive metal plates within the several kinds of solar panels catching these moving platforms, resulting in an electric current. This current is afterward drawn out of the solar panel through metal conductors that will be used as electricity.
Inverter Conversion
The electric current formed by the solar panels for the home is in DC (direct current) form, which later on gets converted into AC (alternating current) through an inverter. AC is the standard form of electricity normally used in homes and businesses.
Utilization or Storage
Lastly, all the converted AC electricity can be used to power devices and appliances in the home. Otherwise, you can accumulate it in a battery as well for future use. It will be beneficial for you at that time when there will be no light, mainly at the time of night.
Best Solar Panels for Home: A Guide to the Included Components
See what components are in the process, right from the solar panel installation to the end note of forming electric power.
Inverters
A solar inverter transforms all the DC generated from our best solar panels for home use into AC that can light up your entire house. Primarily, there are three kinds of inverters available: string inverters, micro – inverters and power optimizers. So, get hold of the inverter that seems perfect for your system size and demands.
Battery Storage
If you already have a battery storage system from one of the best solar panel company in India, you can effortlessly store extra energy for cloudy or night – time. It will prove to be advantageous for an off-grid system or homeowners looking forward to boosting their energy independence.
Mounting Systems
Mounting systems are a must for installing the best solar panels in homes in India. It serves as a main hinge to join solar panels either to your roof or the ground. The type of mounts you use is completely dependent on your installation. Apart from this, you must use something to fix such mounts or even a ground-mounted system.
Best Solar Panels for Home: Decided as Per Your Need
Whether you are dreaming of lighting your home or want to build a sustainable future, understanding on-grid and off-grid solar systems is the ideal way.
On-Grid Solar System
This system utilizes photovoltaic panels to produce solar energy, which is directly merged with the local electricity grid. It permits users to use solar energy for their homes and can rely on the grid for backup. Excess energy can be fed back to the grid to earn credits through net metering programs.
Off-Grid Solar System
In contrast to on-grid, if we talk about off-grid solar systems, they function independently from the utility grid. It involves the usage of solar panels and battery storage to produce electricity. It is fit for all remote areas or locations with unreliable grid setups. Complemented with inverters and charge controllers, they ensure a stable power supply, cutting dependence on fossil fuels.
Certain Guidelines to Pick the Best Solar Panels for Home
Here are the things that you shouldn’t forget while choosing the ideal solar panels for your house.
Inspecting your business needs
The first step in choosing the best solar panels for home is to identify your requirements. Check the electricity consumption of your place to figure out what solar capacity you need. As a general idea for you, a 1 kW solar panel can power around 20 LED bulbs of 9 Watt each.
In case you feel that you can’t figure it out, read it all till the end.

Having your house in a low irradiance place, no need to worry, as our Monoperc Bifacial panel can effortlessly enhance your energy generation throughout the day.
N-TOPCon Bifacial (G2G)
Known to deliver maximum output, our N-TOPCon Bifacial solar panel captures sunlight from both sides. It optimizes energy generation even in reflective and low-light environments. It harnesses energy from the front and reflected sunlight, maximizing the energy yield. If you are living in areas prone to harsh weather conditions, it is the ideal option for you to go with.
Potential of Home Value Increment
Several research studies show that installing the best solar panels in your residence can boost the property’s resale value. 85% of the real estate geeks experienced that including eco-friendly features turns the property into a premium one and inflates the price as well. Hence, add solar panels to your house to attain a tangible financial asset.

Once you are done with the best solar panels for home, having a certified and experienced installer is necessary. It is demanded to take care of securing permits, regulating panel wiring, suggesting placement specifics, and executing post-installation maintenance.
Follow these guidelines no matter what the case is to get hold of the best solar panels for home in India.
Aspects to Scrutinize for the Best Solar Panels for Home
Some of the aspects to note for picking up the best solar panels for your home. Go through these carefully.
Level of Efficiency
The efficiency rate shows the power of a solar panel in turning sunlight into electricity. Tilting towards higher efficiency panels for generating more power in a confined space is useful when you have limited roof space. For this, N-TOPCon panels always come out on top as the best solar panels for home use.
Durability and Warranty
Solar panels for homes are a long-term investment; thus, pick one that is robust and comes with a long warranty period. The standard bar of the warranty for all panels is 25+ years, but the quality and reliability on the warranty can differ from the manufacturer’s side.
Cost & Budget
It seems that higher-efficiency panels (N-TOPCon panels) are more costly at first, but these will prove economical in the long run. Think, analyze, and calculate whether it is worth paying for it in terms of energy savings, considering the future.
Aesthetic Considerations
Solar panels can also be a reason to enhance the overall look of your house, as they come in various designs.

Finalizing the best solar company in India is as crucial as selecting the best solar panels for home. Therefore, to close the deal with a company, you should pose the questions laid down below.
How many years of experience do you have in installing solar systems in homes or residences?
Will your team take care of the permits and handle all the paperwork requirements?
Can you please share some of your previous work? Or like 3-4 case studies for some identical residential projects?
What services do you offer in the matter of post-installation warranty and maintenance?
Asking these questions will increase your ROI by kicking out all the risks. So, keep all these in your mind.

text:
Policy & SubsidyJul 22, 2025·9 min read
Maximize Your Solar Benefits: Navigate Every Scheme Seamlessly with Saatvik
All Blogs
India is swiftly moving towards a clean energy future, and solar power is at the core of this transformation. The government is focusing on this as it recognizes the urgency of climate action and the need for sustainable energy access. It has given rise to various schemes to promote solar adoption across residential, agricultural, community, and industrial sectors. The opportunities are vast, from subsidies to tax incentives, but the complexities can be overwhelming.
Here, Saatvik Solar comes into the picture. With a strong portfolio of high-efficiency solar modules, advanced EPC capabilities, and a deep knowledge of regulatory frameworks, Saatvik empowers customers to get the maximum out of these government schemes. This blog sheds light on Saatvik Solar’s alignment with these central and state-level solar initiatives and how customers can leverage these benefits while being with Saatvik Solar.
A Thorough Analysis of Government Schemes with Saatvik Solar
1. PM Surya Ghar Yojana (Residential Subsidy)
Overview of the Scheme
Introduced in the early phase of 2024, PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana aims to power up residential households by subsidizing rooftop solar installations. It offers a cumulative subsidy of Rs 30,000 per kW for systems up to 2 kW, and Rs 18,000 per kW for additional capacity up to 3 kW. The maximum cap of the subsidy one can gain is Rs 78,000 per household.
What Saatvik Does Under This Scheme?
Saatvik Solar has its forte in designing and installing rooftop solar panels to fit your household needs. By assessing a home’s needs or monthly electricity usage, Saatvik can recommend the optimal solar solution:
Saatvik turnkey solutions comprise handling all the documentation and compliance requirements for subsidy approval. It includes property proof, electricity bills, technical specifications, and net meter installation certificates.
How Customers Can Leverage Saatvik?
Maximize Subsidy
Install a system with a capacity of 3 KW to get hold of the subsidy.
End-to-End Support
Utilize Saatvik’s expertise to go through the application processes, ensuring timely approvals and seamless installation.
Energy Savings
Seek benefit from up to 300 units of free solar electricity monthly, leading to a reduction in your electricity bills.
Net Metering
Saatvik facilitates a net metering setup so households can easily sell back power to the grid and save more.
2. KUSUM Yojana (Agriculture Solar Pump Subsidy)
Outline of the Scheme
The PM-KUSUM or Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthaan Mahabiyan schemes target the solarization of agriculture under three major components:
Component
Target
RE capacity targeted (In GW)
Component A
Setting up 10000 MW of decentralized ground/stilt-mounted grid-connected solar or some other renewables-based power plants
10
Component B
Installation of around 14 lakh standalone solar-powered agriculture plants
7
Component C
Solarization of around 35 lakh existing individual grid-connected agriculture pumps, even involving the feeder level solarization
17.8
This scheme promotes the act of de-dieselization of farms, energy security, and increased farmer income with substantial central financial support.
How does Saatvik come under this scheme?
Saatvik offers customized solar pump solutions for farmers and agricultural enterprises, including:
Installation of solar pumps on cultivated land with stilt-mounted panels to make sure that farmers can achieve what they want without any disruption.
Development of decentralized solar power plants on fallow land.
Incorporation of solar pumps with existing grid connections to cut down diesel dependence and power costs.
How Saatvik Can Be an Asset for Customers?
Farmers and Farmer Producer Organizations
Saatvik can easily let you leverage the subsidies and technical support for solar pump installation under PM-KUSUM.
Maximize Income
Use Saatvik’s solutions to erase diesel costs and potentially sell excess power back to the grid under component A.
Sustainable Farming
Adopt solar irrigation methods with Saatvik to increase water and energy security while lessening the carbon footprint.
3. Group Housing / RWA Subsidy Scheme
Most of the states and utilities offer additional subsidies or incentives for group housing societies and Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs) to promote the installation of rooftop solar systems. These schemes generally complement central subsidies and encourage the adoption of solar.
How Saatvik Fits in this Scheme?
Saatvik works in close collaboration with RWAs and group housing societies to design scalable solar rooftop systems that can fulfill their collective energy needs. It includes:
Performing energy audits for the entire society or housing complex.
Designing systems that refine rooftop space across multiple buildings.
Facilitating the applications of group subsidy and coordination with DISCOMs for net metering.
Ways Saatvik helps customers to power up
Collective Bargaining
RWAs can come at a better pricing and financial option with the help of Saatvik’s bulk installation capabilities.
Enhanced Subsidies
Can merge central and state-level subsidies to reduce the upfront costs.
Shared Savings
Enable all residents to get the perks of negligible electricity bills and surplus power sales.
4. State-specific Additional Subsidies
Before stepping onto the state-specific additional subsidies, let’s see what the central government gave us. It comes under the tag of CFA for residential customers. It provides CFA of 60% of benchmark costs for 2 kW RTS systems and for next additional kW, 40% of benchmark costs. The CFA is capped at last at 3 kW, and for this, more details are given here in the table.

To avail the CFA, it is necessary, as directed by the Government of India, to procure only the modules that are approved under the ALMM.
On top of the central schemes, most of the states provide subsidies or incentives to promote solar adoption. For instance, Gujarat and Maharashtra offer state financial assistance for rooftop solar, which is mainly linked with the PM Surya Ghar Scheme.

text:

On-Grid Solar Inverter Efficiency: What It Means & Why It Matters for Your ROI - Top Solar Pv Module Manufacturers
All Blogs
In today’s energy-centric world, people are embracing solar energy, making the world a better place. However, one metric that they often overlook is on-grid solar inverter efficiency. Yes, it is true that solar panels always take the spotlight, but it is the inverter that converts solar-generated DC into usable AC. Efficiency is crucial to consider, as even small differences can become the reason for significant loss or lower overtime savings.
This article here lets you understand the GTI solar inverter efficiency in detail so that you can make smarter decisions while setting up or upgrading your current solar system.
On-grid Solar Inverter Efficiency: A Basic Understanding
Inverter efficiency directly affects the inverter conversion of direct current generated from solar panels to alternating current (AC) used by household appliances, machinery, and the electrical grid. During this conversion, some of the power is always released in the form of heat. Thus, on-grid solar inverter efficiency tells us how much the inverter preserved and delivered to us as usable power.
In simple words, if the inverter efficiency is 98%, it is converting 98% of the power coming from the panels, while the other 2% gets lost during conversion. The higher this number is, the higher your entire solar system is performing.
Solar power inverter efficiency influences your ROI in the long run. Lower efficiency means lower energy is getting wasted that can lead to significant losses over the years of operation.
How to calculate your on-grid solar inverter efficiency?
Consider how to calculate the on-grid solar inverter efficiency to compare and choose the best model. The formula for the same is too easy.
Inverter efficiency (%) = (AC Output Power ÷ DC Input Power) × 100
For instance, your solar power Inverter receives 1000 watts (W) of DC power from your panels and then converts it to 980 W of AC power. The calculation of the same will be like:
(980 ÷ 1000) × 100 = 98% efficiency
What Is the Bar of Good On-Grid Solar Inverter Efficiency?
So, the primary question upon which everyone kind of stuck is while buying a GTI solar inverter what to look for in terms of efficiency? According to the general thumb rule, all the modern on-grid solar inverter has efficiency of minimally 95%. Whereas the premium models often exceed the bar of 97%, and some of the top-notch pieces now boast peak efficiency of 98.5% or higher.
Witness the table for the easy breakdown.
Efficiency Rating
Performance Level
< 93%
Low (outdated or inefficient)
93%–95%
Average
95%–97%

Excellent (high-end models)
In short, the best on -grid solar inverter is that whose efficiency remains high even in real-world conditions, not only in the lab tests. While purchasing a solar power inverter, always prioritize not only the peak efficiency but also check for the field performance and certifications like IEC and BIS. It is necessary to mention here that Saatvik Green Energy Limited’s Uday Series on-grid solar inverter has an efficiency of up to 98.7%.
Factors Deeply Affecting On-Grid Solar Inverter Efficiency
Several factors exist that can uplift or decrease the efficiency bar of your solar power inverter. Continue reading to know these factors.
Internal Design & Technology
The core of the solar inverter lies in its design and technology it inheres, which mainly influences its efficiency. Modern inverters increasingly utilize advanced materials like Silicon Carbide (SiC) and gallium nitrate (GaN). These materials permit faster switching speed and lower resistance during conversion, leading to higher on-grid solar inverter efficiency.
Besides this, design components like cooling mechanisms (active fans, passive heatsinks) and infused Maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithms boost the overall efficiency. Apt cooling eliminates thermal stress on components while MPPT ensures that the inverter operates at an optimal temperature, maximizing the energy extracted.
Inverter Sizing and Alignment with Panels
Choosing the right size on-grid solar inverter to match your panels is essential, as it directly impacts your efficiency. A small inverter in relation to the panels can’t handle the incoming power, leading to overloading.
On the other hand, an oversized on-grid solar inverter might operate under low load conditions, where efficiency will drop. This mismatch makes your inverter run less on efficiency over time, wasting the potential energy gains.
The ideal way here is to match your inverter with the solar panels’ maximum output and load profiles, ensuring it operates at its peak efficiency range. Matching both not only refines the inverter efficiency but also cuts down stress on components, expanding the system’s operational life.
Suitable Temperature & Installation Environment
Environmental factors. specifically ambient temperature and installation conditions have a surprisingly strong impact on on-grid solar inverter efficiency. Electronic components inside the solar power inverter generate heat, reduce efficiency, and ultimately shorten the inverter’s lifespan.
High temperatures elevate the resistance in power semiconductors and degrade cooling efficiency, increasing the energy loss. For example, a solar power inverter places in a shed and a well-ventilated area may keep the efficiency close to its rated value, while the same inverter placed exposed to sunlight may drop efficiency by a few percentage points.
Dust and dirt can block the ventilation paths, causing the temperature to rise even more. Therefore, regular cleaning and maintenance are needed to ensure that the inverter cooling functions work properly.
How To Trace & Maintain Your On-Grid Solar Inverter Efficiency?
Keeping up the peak on-grid solar inverter efficiency throughout the lifespan requires consistent monitoring and time-to-time maintenance.
Visual Inspections & Cleaning
Regular visual checks can let you know about dust, corrosion, and signs of overheating. Cleaning dusts from vents and fans can maintain proper airflow, crucial for cooling and preventing efficiency losses.
Environmental Control
Make sure that the on-grid solar inverter is placed in a well-ventilated and shaded area as it helped inverter from heat buildup, directly support sustained efficiency.
Professional Servicing
Scheduling annual servicing with a certified technical person ensures that internal components will work properly, firmware remains updated, and any damage part will get change before it hampers performance.
By merging these maintenance and monitoring practices, you can easily extend your on-grid solar inverter lifespan and maintain a high efficiency level, leading to maximum ROI.
Summing Up!
When it comes to the output of the solar inverter, the on-grid solar inverter efficiency plays a crucial role. Right from the choice of technology to installation and maintenance, every detail matters.
Investing in an on-grid solar inverter with high efficiency pays off in the long run. Keep the things in mind that can keep the same level of efficiency of your inverter throughout its lifespan. It will certainly reduce your carbon footprint and will make you attain financial benefits as well. So, make the smart move now because every decision matters.
Looking for high on-grid solar inverter efficiency? Check the Saatvik Uday Series, comprising single and three-phase both. Connect and take the next step for a sustainable future.
FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)
1. Do on-grid solar inverters become less efficient over time?
Yes, on-grid solar inverters generally experience a gradual decline in their efficiency due to component aging, heat generation, etc. However, with proper maintenance, you can maintain the same level for around 10 years.
2. Does inverter sizing affect the solar power inverter efficiency?
Certainly. Proper sizing of the inverter aligned with the solar panels kicks out the energy loss from power clipping (If undersized) and low-load efficiency (in case of oversized). An on-grid solar inverter sized between 80% to 110% of the panel capacity typically offers the best efficiency.
3. Can I remotely monitor the installed on-grid solar inverter efficiency?
It is possible now. As most of the modern GTI inverters comes with a monitoring app or software for better connectivity. It can let you witness the performance of your inverter from the comfort of any place.
4. How can I increase my solar inverter efficiency?
To increase the same, follow these pointers:
Always choose the high-efficiency inverters (97% or above) to keep the energy loss to a bare minimum.
Make a habit of regularly updating the firmware for seamless performance.
Ensure to place the inverter in a shaded and well-ventilated area to avoid thermal impact.

Thinking of switching to solar? Great decision! But wait — before you choose the panels and call the installer, there’s one thing you must understand: what type of solar system do you need — Off-Grid or On-Grid?
Don’t worry, we’ll break it down in simple terms so you don’t have to Google ten more articles after this. Let’s go!
What is an On-Grid Solar System?
An On-Grid Solar System, also known as a grid-connected or grid-tied system, is the most commonly used solar setup in cities and towns across India.
It means your solar power system is directly linked to the main electricity grid — the same one you’ve been using all along (run by your local DISCOM or electricity board).
Here’s how it works:
Your solar panels absorb sunlight during the day and convert it into electricity.
You first use that power for your home or office’s needs (fans, lights, ACs, etc.).
If your panels produce extra power, it’s sent back to the grid.
At night or during low sunlight, you draw power from the grid.
This system is ideal when you want to save on electricity bills but don’t need batteries.
Best Suited For:
People living in cities with stable electricity
Homeowners who want to save on monthly bills
Offices and businesses using commercial solar panels
Anyone who doesn’t want the extra cost of batteries
What is an Off-Grid Solar System?
An Off-Grid Solar System is a completely independent setup — it works without any connection to the electricity grid.
This system is powered by solar panels + battery storage. That means all the electricity your system generates is either used immediately or stored in batteries for later use.
How It Works:
Solar panels generate electricity during the day.
Your appliances run using solar power.
Extra power gets stored in the battery bank.
At night or during power demand, the system uses the stored battery power.
You don’t depend on any external power source — it’s like having your own mini power station at home.
Remote areas with no access to grid electricity
Homes with frequent power cuts
Farms, guesthouses, and schools in rural areas
People who want to be 100% energy-independent

Which One Should You Choose?
If you’re living in a city or town with a decent power supply and want to save on bills, an On-Grid system is your best bet. It’s more affordable, and you get the benefit of net metering, which means the grid pays you for the extra power you generate. Win-win!
If you’re in a location with frequent power cuts or where there’s no electricity grid at all, then an Off-Grid system is more suitable. It’s a bit of an investment because of the battery, but the peace of mind is worth it.
Whether It’s a Home, Shop, or Factory — Solar Works!
Whether you’re looking to power a residential building, a retail store, or a manufacturing unit, choosing the right system matters. From residential solar panels to large commercial solar panels, your setup should match your needs.
And here’s a pro tip — no matter which system you choose, always go with trusted experts.

Expert guidance on choosing between Off-Grid and On-Grid Solar Systems

What You Should Remember
Solar is the future, but it’s important to choose the right path. Whether you want to stay connected with the grid or go fully self-reliant, understanding the difference between Off-Grid and On-Grid Solar Systems will help you make the most out of your investment.
Interested in going solar? Let’s find the right solar panel system for your home or business. Talk to Saatvik Solar today, and make the sun work for you!
FAQs
Q1. I live in a city like Delhi or Pune. Which system should I go for?
If you live in a city with proper electricity supply, an On-Grid Solar System is the best option. It helps you save money through net metering and you don’t need batteries. It’s ideal for installing residential solar panels in urban homes.
Q2. Will an Off-Grid system keep my home powered during load-shedding?
Yes! A major advantage of an Off-Grid Solar System is that it works even during power cuts because it uses battery backup. It’s the right choice for remote areas or towns where grid electricity is unreliable.
Q3. Can I fully run my home on solar with an Off-Grid setup?
You can, but you’ll need enough solar panels for your home, along with a good battery setup. If you use heavy appliances like ACs or geysers, make sure the system is designed accordingly. It’s doable, but better planned by experts.
Q4. Can I switch from On-Grid to Off-Grid later on?
Yes, it’s possible — but it involves changes in your system like adding batteries and modifying the inverter setup. So, it’s always better to plan your solar system based on your long-term goals before installation.
Q5. I want both savings and backup power — what should I do?
In that case, you can go for a hybrid system — a mix of Off-Grid and On-Grid Solar System. It lets you enjoy net metering benefits while still having backup power during outages. Many solar panel manufacturers offer this solution now.

sections.heading: What is an On-Grid Solar System?
sections.text: An On-Grid Solar System, also known as a grid-connected or grid-tied system, is the most commonly used solar setup in cities and towns across India. It means your solar power system is directly linked to the main electricity grid — the same one you’ve been using all along (run by your local DISCOM or electricity board).

sections.heading: Here’s how it works:
sections.text: Your solar panels absorb sunlight during the day and convert it into electricity. You first use that power for your home or office’s needs (fans, lights, ACs, etc.). If your panels produce extra power, it’s sent back to the grid. At night or during low sunlight, you draw power from the grid. This system is ideal when you want to save on electricity bills but don’t need batteries.

sections.heading: Best Suited For:
sections.text: People living in cities with stable electricity Homeowners who want to save on monthly bills Offices and businesses using commercial solar panels Anyone who doesn’t want the extra cost of batteries

sections.heading: What is an Off-Grid Solar System?
sections.text: An Off-Grid Solar System is a completely independent setup — it works without any connection to the electricity grid. This system is powered by solar panels + battery storage. That means all the electricity your system generates is either used immediately or stored in batteries for later use.

sections.heading: How It Works:
sections.text: Solar panels generate electricity during the day. Your appliances run using solar power. Extra power gets stored in the battery bank. At night or during power demand, the system uses the stored battery power. You don’t depend on any external power source — it’s like having your own mini power station at home.

sections.heading: Difference Between On-Grid and Off-Grid
sections.text: Feature On-Grid System Off-Grid System Grid Connection Yes No Batteries Required No Yes Net Metering Benefit Available Not Applicable Backup During Outage No (unless hybrid) Yes Ideal For Cities, homes, offices Rural areas, farms, and remote sites Cost Relatively lower Higher due to battery costs

sections.heading: Which One Should You Choose?
sections.text: If you’re living in a city or town with a decent power supply and want to save on bills, an On-Grid system is your best bet. It’s more affordable, and you get the benefit of net metering, which means the grid pays you for the extra power you generate. Win-win! If you’re in a location with frequent power cuts or where there’s no electricity grid at all, then an Off-Grid system is more suitable. It’s a bit of an investment because of the battery, but the peace of mind is worth it.

How To Get Started with Solar Panel Installation for Home?

Register on the portal

As India is marching towards being a renewable powerhouse, all homeowners have a golden opportunity for a dual change: contributing to the environment and reducing electricity bills.

The ideal answer for this is to go ahead with solar panel installation for home. It is the simplest way to reduce electricity bills by up to 80%. A branded or reputed solar module has a general life span of 25+ years and continues to perform as it was in the early stage.

In short, even if you get solar panel installation done at your place, you’ll get your electricity bill. The statement shows that you don’t have to pay anything, but it will show you the monthly consumption in comparison with net metering credits.

Reading your electricity bill after the solar panel installation involves a major understanding of the relation of solar panels with the grid and how your bill reflects that interaction. text:

Solar Energy In India for a Sustainable Future
All Blogs
India stands at a pivotal moment in its expansion phase, where economic growth should go hand-in-hand with environmental sustainability. There are solutions for a greener future, but solar energy in India emerges as the key driver. The constant efforts of India are bearing fruit. India is planning to become a self-reliant solar energy-producing nation and aims to produce five tons of green hydrogen by the end of 2030. Don’t think of solar energy as just the solution to India’s energy hurdle, but also as the way to attain sustainable development goals.
Let’s walk down till the end of this write-up to witness how solar is the essence behind the making of a sustainable India.
Scenario of Growing Demand for Solar Energy in India
No one disagrees, “India is one of the fastest-growing economies in the world,” and with this, the demand for energy also grows in parallelly. A study shows that the energy consumption of India is expected to double by the end of 2040.
Before the advent of solar energy, coal was the primary & dominant source of electricity, causing pollution and greenhouse gas emissions. To tackle this and stand by the global climate guidelines, India has been rapidly shifting towards renewable energy, with solar energy leading at the front.
Why Solar Energy in India Is Imperative for a Sustainable Future?
The need for greener energy sources has increased, apparently, in today’s context. Several problems in conventional energy elevate solar energy in India and highlight the importance of greener energy sources. Here is a comparison given between solar energy and conventional energy, enough to explain why the first one is better.
Conventional energy sources, including fossil fuels, cause the depletion of fossils; in contrast, solar energy demands sunlight only.
Conventional sources of energy are limited, but sunlight is available in abundance.
High fuel costs and operational expenses are included in conventional energy sources. On the other hand, though the starting cost of solar power plants is high, it will certainly give long-term savings.
Furthermore, solar panel installations are flexible and can easily be deployed in diverse settings, right from large utility-scale parks to rooftop systems in both rural and urban areas. This decentralized nature of solar energy makes sure that even remote villages can get hold of clean electricity.
Role of Solar Energy in India’s Sustainable Development
Solar is not just a way of lighting but an important aspect of sustainable development initiatives. Having understood the relation between solar energy and sustainable development, look at where solar energy in India is leaving its impact.
The use of solar energy pushes us away from the dependency on the import of fossil fuels. It boosts national security while protecting the economy from the volatility of international oil prices.
Another benefit of solar energy projects is that they can engage community members in the implementation process. It leads to accountability, thus promoting a sense of sustainability and community involvement.
Resilience Against Climate Change
Solar energy can easily adapt to the effects of climate change. For instance, decentralized solar power installation can generate power even during calamities when the main power supply infrastructure can collapse; critical functions must proceed.
Government Initiatives Driving Adoption of Solar Energy in India
The Indian government has been so impressive in promoting solar energy in India by implementing various initiatives. It is justified by the National Solar Mission, launched in 2010, which targets to install 100 GW of solar capacity by the end of 2022. While this target has faced some delays, it has sparked crucial momentum in the domain. In recent times, the government has altered its target to attain 280 GW of solar capacity by 2030 as a part of its broader goal of 500 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity.
The Indian government is striving really hard for the future of solar energy in India and has initiated schemes like PM-KUSUM. What they are aiming for is to solarize agriculture by empowering the farmers to install solar pumps. It will reduce the level of reliance they have on diesel and on-grid electricity. Now, all the residential and commercial users can fetch clean energy seamlessly because of subsidies and incentives.
Leading the Change to Solar for Sustainable India
As India stands on top by embracing solar energy with both hands, companies in the solar domain are critical in hastening this shift. They are not only focusing on India’s energy needs but also setting some touchstones for the solar manufacturing ecosystem.
Top-of-the-range manufacturing facilities, a focus on producing high-efficiency modules like Mono PERC & N-Type TOPCon, and an expansive distribution network are all what’s going on in such companies. These things reflect their robust vision of being a key player in India’s green journey.
Towards a Greener Future!
The path to a sustainable India is certainly illuminated by the sun. Solar Energy in India isn’t an alternative — it is an imperative. It will take care of all the environmental concerns, solidify energy security, and accelerate inclusive growth.
Through ongoing investment, policy implementation, and public awareness, solar energy will indeed transform India’s energy landscape and help in building a cleaner, prosperous, and sustainable nation.
Embracing solar will not just let India harness the power of the sun but also let it empower itself for a better future.

text:
ModulesJul 3, 2025·7 min read
Solar Panel Installation: A Step-by-Step Detailed Guide for 2025
All Blogs
Adopting solar energy is surely a game-changer for reducing electricity bills and diminishing carbon footprints. As energy costs rise daily and the push for eco-friendly solutions becomes more solid, many people are turning towards solar energy through solar panel installation. It is certainly a reliable and cost-effective energy source.
Take a deep dive into this guide to get familiar with every detail you need to know about solar panel installation.
Key Things To Consider Before Solar Panel Installation
Consider these factors before stepping ahead with solar panel installation.
Analyse the Energy Requirements
The average electrical consumption of a house or a place is expressed in Kilowatt hours (kWh). So, notice the average consumption of electricity for at least 1 to 3 months.
Capture your solar potential
Ensure that the solar panels get more than adequate sunlight all day by accurately positioning them. Make sure that the shadow of trees or other houses won’t fall on it.
Pick the right solar system
Choose either an on-grid or an off-grid solar system. The on-grid system works along with the framework and permits you to add some extra power if needed. In contrast, in an off-grid system add a battery storage for power during night or power cutoffs.
Budget Planning
Calculate the total cost of the solar system before solar panel installation. Remember, it includes the cost of inverters, batteries, wiring, and mounting structures.
Check for inspections and permits
Ensure you checked or adhered to the local regulations and got all the needed permits for the installation of solar panels at home.
Types of Solar Mount for Solar Panel Installation
The Mounting source is the primary reason for your solar panels’ total efficiency. The type of mounting you will choose for solar panel installation generally depends on your environment and where you are planning to get them installed.
The most common kind of solar mounting is as follows:
Pole Mount
Under this, a pole is installed that elevates your solar panel system for better exposure to the sunlight. It is usually tilted to a certain angle for better solar coverage.
Roof-Ground Mount
This type can be placed either as flat or sloped for the ground or the roof. Roof-ground mount is the more general and effective way for panels to receive maximum sunlight.
Flush Mount
It is ideal for areas with lots of wind because it offers you with utmost flexibility and minimal interference from the roof drains.
Take care of the process of mounting during solar panel installation if you want optimal performance. It can make a difference in the performance of your panels.
Step-By-Step Solar Panel Installation Process
Once you have evaluated all the things that are necessary to consider before solar panel installation, go with the steps given below for solar panel installation for home in India. Don’t disturb the flow, follow as they are mentioned here.
Install the Mounting Structure
The mounting structure is the cornerstone of your solar panel installation. It had to be fixed securely with a tilt angle of 15-20 degrees to escalate the sunlight exposure. Make sure that the structure can tolerate all the weather conditions in India.
Mount Solar Panels
Fix the panels over the mounting structure and fix them with stainless steel nuts and bolts. Always leave a small gap between the panels for thermal expansion, leading to top-notch durability and efficiency during solar panel installation for home.
Done Connecting & Wiring Panels
Next to this, connect all the panels by using MC4 connectors. Depending on your system, go with one of these:
Series connection: It pushes up the voltage while maintaining the value of the current static.
Parallel Connection: It does the opposite by increasing the current while maintaining the voltage.
Check twice the connection of polarities to prevent any damage during the solar panel installation process.
Establish connection with Inverter
The inverter is necessary to convert the power from solar panels into usable energy for your home. Be cautious of merging the negative and positive terminals to the inverter correctly.
Incorporate Battery Storage
It is quite optional. If there are off-grid systems, connect the inverter to the battery. It will make sure that excess energy produced during the day gets stored in a battery and can be used at night or during power cutoffs.
Form a connection with the grid
In on-grid systems, link the inverter directly to the power supply. It lets the excess energy accumulation back into the grid, making you gain credits under the net metering schemes.
Ensure Proper Earthing
Earthing is one of the crucial safety measures when it comes to rooftop solar panel installation. Leverage high-quality materials to make it all compatible with the panels, inverter, and other components, to avoid any electrical hazards.
Test & Activate the System
Turn on the inverter and inspect the system’s output to make sure that it works as intended. Check the inverter display to gather real-time updates on energy generation and usage.
How long does it take for Solar Panel Installation?
The standard time for solar panel installation for homes is about 2-3 days in general cases, depending on the conditions.
Mostly, the time spent is on the task of installing the scaffolding and other necessary safety features.
There are some other factors as well that can hamper the timeline such as the complexity of solar panel installation and the weather.
Should I go with the Solar Panel Installation for my home by myself ?
It is possible to go with solar panel installation on your own. However, as a reputed Solar panel installation company, we do not suggest this for safety and efficiency reasons.
It is always better to rely on professionals for solar panel installation to minimize the risk of accidents and to get the most out of the panels in terms of performance.
Solar panel installation is also considered as “permitted development”, so you need to do planning and have to get permission to set this up.
Common Mistakes To Avoid For Solar Panel Installation
When it is about solar panel installation, most people make these mistakes:
Underestimating the energy needs
Avoid the mistake of installing fewer solar panels after accurately inspecting your energy consumption to ensure that it will fulfill your needs.
Neglecting the roof inspection
Before solar panel installation, inspect your roof size, space, orientation, and placement to figure out the suitability of solar panel fixtures and maximize sunlight exposure.
Ignoring Maintenance Call
Regularly check and maintain your solar panels to prevent the issue of dirt accumulation and shading that can reduce production and efficiency over time.
Disregarding safety measures
Always put safety on top during solar panel installation by following safety measures, securing panels correctly, and preventing electrical hazards to avoid accidents and damage to the property.
Improper Installation
Hire a certified and professional solar panel installation company like Saatvik Solar for proper installation, wiring, and alignment of solar panels for unmatched efficiency.
Follow the above-given steps to prevent the general mistakes that occur during solar panel installation.
Concluding Note
Solar panel installation is a wise choice in this world of rising costs. Right from reducing the electricity bills to a more positive environmental impact, this upgrade is worth the investment. It will make you energy independent. Check your home or premise energy needs and go with solar with a skillful solar panel installation company like Saatvik Solar.
Enjoy a greener, brighter, cleaner, and sustainable future by embracing solar energy today!
FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)
1. Is it possible to fully power up the house with solar panel installation?
Yes, it is possible, a well-designed solar panel installation can power a house easily. However, factors like energy usage, sunlight availability, and the inclusion of batteries can play a significant role.
2. Can I perform Solar panel installation for my home on my own?
Solar panel installation for home in India can be done by individuals, but it is not advised as such. Instead, it is suggested to hire a professional solar panel installation company like Saatvik Solar. It will avoid the emergence of safety concerns, system efficiency, and non-compliance with laws/regulations. Moreover, these professionals also come with warranty and maintenance services as well.
3. what is the cost of solar panel installation in India?
The solar panel installation cost varies too much. It depends on what requirements you have. A lot of other factors are also involved in the same. These are the size of the solar system, mounting structure, types of panels, Installation location, and subsidy and Solar panel installation government schemes.

Eligibility Criteria to get Solar Panel Subsidy in 2026
You only become eligible for a solar panel subsidy if:
You are a residential property owner
Net-metering is approved by the DISCOM
Solar panel system installed by an approved vendor
Solar panel must remain grid-connected
Install solar panel components that meet the MNRE standards
Certain conditions are there upon which solar subsidy is not applicable; these are:
Off-grid solar systems
Battery-only system

Documents needed to avail a solar panel subsidy in 2026

Aadhaar card

There are 3 kinds of government solar panel subsidies available, and one of them is a few state-based subsidy programs.
PM Surya Ghar: MUFT BIJLI YOJANA
PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana was launched by the Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2024 with the mission of installing more than 1 crore rooftop solar panels. This is primarily for those people who can’t afford but want to switch to solar.
Under the central government-backed solar panel subsidy in India, you can get financial aid of Rs 30,000 to Rs 78,000. The solar panel system must be between 1 kW and 3 kW in capacity. Besides this, all the group housing society (GHS)/Resident welfare association (RWS) can also claim a solar panel subsidy of Rs 18,000 per kW.
Under this scheme, the solar panel subsidy is based on capacity:
1-2 kW: Rs 30,000 to Rs 60,000
2-3 kW: Rs 60,000 to 78,000
Above 3 kW: Rs 78,000
You can take a call for capacity depending on your electricity consumption.

Homeowners can enjoy free electricity with minimal cost.
Encourage the usage of renewable energy.

Cut down the electricity cost for both the utility and the government.
PM KUSUM
PM KUSUM stands for Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan. This scheme was laid down by MNRE to offer solar subsidies for farmers and agriculture-based institutions.
It comprises three major components:
Component A: Decentralized solar power plants
In this component, the government offers 60% subsidy and 30% less interest loan to assist the farmers, FPOs, Panchayats, and local institutions to install solar panel. The generated power can be used by them. Moreover, excess power can be sold to the authorized DISCOM to make some income.
Component B: Standalone Off-grid solar pumps
Individual farmers who are in remote location or low-grid areas can easily enhance their irrigation by using solar pumps. The central solar panel subsidy in India will almost cover 60% of the cost. Whereas to pay the remaining amount, the farmer can take a loan on low interest rate.
Component C: Solarization of Grid-connected pumps & feeders
All the individual farmers can attain a subsidy on solarization of existing grid-connected pumps & feeders.
The farmers for this can get up to 60% subsidy from the central and state governments. For grid pumps, they can effortlessly avail a loan from a bank, and for feeders, they can avail a loan from NABARD or PFC/REC.
Apart from this, if you are in the Northeastern states, Ladakh, Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Lakshadweep, and Andaman & Nicobar Islands, you can fetch up to 50% government subsidy for solar panels for off-grid pumps, grid-connected pumps, and feeders.
Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Programme (MNRE)
The MNRE solar panel subsidy for Grid connected rooftop solar is 40% for solar panel system up to 3 kW capacity and 20% for the capacity between 3 kW to 10 kW.
The goal of this scheme is to increase the number of rooftop solar panels in India and cut down the usage of fuel-based electricity. All the grid-connected solar panel systems get credit from the government under net metering to reduce their electricity bills.

Solar Panel Warranty: Things You Should Know Before Solar Panel Installation

Switching to solar energy is undoubtedly a smart move for both your wallet and the environment. But to secure your investment in a solar panel system, getting aware of the solar panel warranty is of equal importance. The solar modules warranties ensure that your module performs effectively for years, even after encountering unexpected issues. Covering right from manufacturing defects to issues in long-term energy output, having a strong warranty span will give you peace of mind throughout your entire solar journey.
Navigate through this write-up by Saatvik Green Energy Limited to keep up with the solar panel warranty to back your solar investment. Continue your reading till the end so that you wouldn’t miss anything crucial regarding the warranty to stay protected for decades.
A Brief Overview of Solar Panel Warranty
Solar panel warranty is a period given by the solar panel manufacturer, ensuring that the panels will work properly as expected till that date. Even if panels fail to perform or any fault arises, you will get help or a valuable replacement of the resource.
Regarding Solar Panels, two types of warranties are provided, i.e., product warranty and performance warranty. Let’s understand the types for clarity.
Solar Panel Warranty: Understanding The Types
Product Warranty
The Solar panel product warranty, also referred to as the equipment warranty, covers defects in the materials for a fixed period. In the matter of malfunctions or damages due to manufacturing defects, the manufacturer will be restricted to repair or replace the faulty components at no cost to the customer. Generally, Saatvik Solar Panel product warranty ranges up to 12 years, indicating unmatched quality and durability.
Saatvik Green Energy Limited, a leading solar panel manufacturer, known in the market for their commitment to quality and reliability. By choosing Saatvik panels with a long span solar panel warranty, ensure that you’ll receive maximum value for your investment.
Performance Solar Panel Warranty
Performance solar panel warranty is all about the solar panel output over time, indicating that it maintains a certain level of efficiency throughout its span. Performance warranty guarantees a minimum power output percentage after a fixed span, like 90% output after 10 years and 80% output after 25 years.
Saatvik Solar offers 30 years of performance warranty, providing customers with reliability for the long-term performance of the solar modules. With Saatvik having your back, you don’t have to stress about your solar panels.
Key Factors To Consider When Checking Solar Panel Warranty
When inspecting a solar panel warranty, several factors should be taken into consideration for long-term coverage and maximum value.
Manufacturer Reputation
While choosing a solar panel company, always prefer those with high credibility and a customer satisfaction rate. Saatvik Green Energy Limited is a top solar manufacturer in India, known for its top-notch quality and performance excellence.
Degradation Rate
Please note down the degradation rate outlined in the performance warranty, denoting the decline in panel efficiency. Go with a solar panel with a low degradation rate, showing high quality and long-term performance. Saatvik solar boast lower degradation rate to ensure optimal efficiency for the years to come.
Technical Assistance
Analyse the technical support that the manufacturer imparts throughout the warranty span. Saatvik Solar is striving hard to deliver prompt and stable customer support for any issue that may arise. Relying on Saatvik will let every customer enjoy a sigh of relief knowing that a team of experts is backing them.
Warranty Coverage
Make a habit of thoroughly checking both product and performance warranty, including coverage duration, limitations, and exclusions. Saatvik solar, under these terms offer long-term warranty with extensive coverage and clear terms, offering peace of mind to all customers.
Steps To Perform After Solar Panel Warranty Expiry
As soon as the solar panel warranty get expired, you should perform certain steps to maintain the ROI for your solar panels.
Schedule Regular Maintenance
Once the solar panel warranty expires, scheduling regular check-ups becomes a must to maintain overall solar panel health.
Clean panels every 15 days
Check for the wiring and connections
Test the inverter output
Track the energy production levels
Regular maintenance avoids minor faults from turning into costly problems.
Replace old & aging components
Some parts require replacement once the solar panel warranty ends.
Inverters (typically after 8-10 years)
Monitoring systems
Enroll in Service Plans
Enquire and check out the post-warranty service plans offered by the solar panel company. These plans offer multiple things like preventive maintenance, periodic inspections, and discounted repair services to make your system run efficiently without any disruptions.
We offer regular maintenance and post-warranty service plans that you can access to maintain the performance and efficiency of your solar panel system.
When does the solar panel warranty become nullified?
There is a specified period of solar panel warranty given by various solar panel companies. It comes together with some conditions that may nullified your warranty span.
Faulty Installation by Unauthorized Person
All the solar panel manufacturers like Saatvik Solar, maintain certain conditions regarding installation, and technicians who are authorized to do the installation. To covered under the given solar panel warranty, you should engage certified personnel only available from reputed solar panel companies for solar system installation.
Environmental Damage
Sometimes, natural calamities like storms, floods, and hurricanes arise that lead to damage to the panels. Along with these, falling branches from trees also hampers the modules and it all doesn’t come under the warranty benefits.
Theft
Solar module manufacturers do not cover claims occurs due to theft of panels or any components.
Non-registration of Solar Panel Warranty
Some of the solar panel manufacturers demand for registration of warranty within 30-90 days, for it to be activated. In case, you fail to do the same, your solar panel warranty becomes void.
Lack of Maintenance
Regular maintenance is a must for the superior functioning of the solar panel. Preventing this can lead to the accumulation of dust, which causes the solar panel warranty to eliminate.
All the solar panels manufacturers like Saatvik Solar mention the ideal time intervals and cleaning during which technicians’ services can be availed. Failures in this can disrupt the performance of the panels.
Final Words
All in all, understanding all about solar panel warranty is necessary to invest in solar and gain maximum value by leveraging its long-term benefits. A strong solar panel warranty backs your overall investment and ensures that the panels continue to deliver power throughout their entire lifespan. With Saatvik as your trusted partner, navigate through all the complexities that you face in claiming your warranty.
Whether you are looking for a sustainable energy solution or forming a residential solar project, Saatvik Solar is always here to assist you in any manner.
FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)
1. What does a typical solar panel warranty cover?
Mainly, the solar panel warranty covers both the product and performance warranty offered by the solar panel manufacturer.
2. How can I claim the solar panel warranty if my panels stop working for any reason?
You only must contact the solar installation company along with your installation bill and solar panel warranty papers to claim your warranty.
3. Do all the solar panel manufacturers offers the same type of solar panel warranty?
Solar panel warranty often differs, as per the manufacturer’s warranty policy, and depends on various models of modules.
4. Do solar panels need maintenance instead of a solar panel warranty?
Solar panels require minimal upkeep, but regular cleaning and checkups are needed. Cleaning removes dirt and other things blocking sunlight capturing, while inspections take care of damage, loose wirings, or any kind of performance issues.

Brief on On-Grid Solar Inverter for Home
An on-grid solar inverter for home is an inverter that gets connected to the grid and comes with no battery. When solar panels generate direct current, they convert that DC into AC. And the main benefit of this inverter is that it feeds the excess energy to the grid under the net metering scheme, which will reduce your electricity bill.
Moreover, it is the key component of the entire solar system. Right from extracting the maximum power from the Solar Module and then converting it into the usable ac supply/power for household equipment’s. the on-grid solar inverter for home offers a range of benefits.
Benefits of an On-grid solar inverter for home in 2026
1. Huge Savings on Electricity Bills
One of the top benefits of getting an on-grid home power inverter is the huge reduction in your electricity bill. With the Saatvik Uday Series on-grid solar inverter, you can slash your electricity bill till 80-90%. By generating power from solar energy and feeding the excess back to the grid can decrease your electricity consumption directly from utility company.
2. Environment-friendly Energy
Choosing an on-grid solar inverter for home is a smart move towards a greener future. Solar energy is renewable, clean, and emits zero greenhouse gases. Thus, by installing the best on-grid inverter for home, you are reducing your carbon footprint and contributing to a sustainable place.
3. Increased property value
Homes with a solar system tend to show higher resale value in the market. Prospective buyers and new-age people give priority to homes that offer energy savings and sustainable living. Installing an on-grid solar inverter for home not only cuts down your electricity bill but also makes your home more marketable in the long run.
4. Net Metering Advantage
On-grid solar inverter for home comes with the benefit of Net Metering, a billing scheme that gives credits to the solar system owner who feed excess energy to the grid. If your solar system generates more electricity than is consumed during the day, the excess energy is sent back to the grid, and your meter runs backward, leading you to witness lower electricity charges.
5. No need for battery storage
Unlike off-grid systems, an on-grid solar inverter for home do not require a battery at all to work. They use the energy generated during the day and draw from the grid at night. It reduces the installation cost and eradicates the need of replacement or maintenance of the battery over time.
6. Reliable & Continuous Power Supply
When your solar power inverter for home is connected to the grid, your household enjoys an uninterrupted power supply, even during cloudy days, when solar generation is low. Saatvik on-grid solar inverter for home is so efficiently synchronise easily with DC supply & AC supply to ensure a consistent energy flow.
7. Government Incentives & Subsidies
The government offers several attractive incentives and subsidies to promote the adoption of solar, including tax rebates, grants, etc. By installing an on-grid solar inverter for home, you can avail the benefits under programs like PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, PM KUSUM Yojana, etc. It will cut and optimize your overall investment cost and speed up the ROI.
8. High Efficiency with Advanced Technology
A modern on-grid solar inverter for home is equipped with MPPT (maximum power point tracking) technology, which optimizes solar power generation. These next-gen best on-grid solar inverters continuously extract the maximum energy from solar panels, resulting in higher efficiency and elevated performance.
9. Low Maintenance Costs
An on-grid solar inverter for home demands minimal maintenance. Since this inverter doesn’t have batteries, they are easier and cheaper to maintain than off-grid inverters. All you need to do is to clean solar panels and perform periodic checks of the home power inverter to keep your system running effortlessly.
10. Smart Monitoring & Control
Most of the on-grid solar inverter for home comes with real-time monitoring features, permitting you to trace energy production and usage through mobile apps or online dashboards remotely. This will help you in optimizing energy consumption and identifying issues early for seamless operation of your solar system.

Getting an on-grid solar inverter for home will unleash the complete potential for the rooftop solar panel system. It will provide you with peace of mind as it comes with advanced features, smart remote monitoring, and minimal maintenance costs. With benefits ranging from cost-effectiveness to government subsidies, it is an ideal move for homeowners to save money and pave the way for a sustainable future.

text:
