5 Common Mistakes People Make When Installing Solar Panels
All Blogs
Switching to solar energy is a big and meaningful step for your wallet, your peace of mind, and the planet. But in India, many people jump into this transition without having the full picture. This often leads to regret, reduced performance, or spending more than necessary.
If you’re planning to install residential solar panels here are the top 5 mistakes people commonly make — and how you can avoid them.
Five Common Mistakes When Installing Solar Panels
1. Choosing Low-Quality Panels to Save Money
In an effort to cut costs, many homeowners and businesses end up purchasing panels from unverified sources or local dealers. While the upfront price may seem attractive, these non-certified panels often lack durability, long-term warranties, and performance reliability.
Later, people realise their power generation is far lower than expected, or that the panels degrade quickly, losing efficiency within just a few years. A common regret is not choosing a reputed solar panel manufacturer right from the start.
Instead, opt for a trusted brand like Saatvik Solar, one of the top solar companies in India, recognized for its high-efficiency modules and long-term reliability. Remember, you’re not just buying a product — you’re investing in peace of mind for the next 25 years.
2. Wrong Direction or Angle of Placement
You may have bought top-quality panels, but if they’re not placed in the correct direction or angle, the output will suffer. In India, solar panels should ideally face south with the proper tilt based on your city’s location.
Many installations are done without a proper site survey or solar study. Later, the electricity bill barely drops, and people wonder why solar isn’t working for them. In reality, it’s often a design flaw due to a lack of technical expertise during installation.
At Saatvik, our expert teams ensure that your roof top solar system is engineered smartly for maximum sun exposure and long-term output.
3. No Walkway for Cleaning and Maintenance
In Indian cities and towns, rooftops often have limited space. Some installers cram the panels into every available inch without thinking of future cleaning or access. Soon, dust and pollution reduce panel efficiency, but there’s no safe or easy way to clean them.
This leads to increased maintenance costs and loss of generation, something that could have been avoided with just a bit of smarter planning. Whether it’s a home or an industrial site, maintenance should never be an afterthought.
A good installer will always ensure there’s a walkway for access, especially in areas with high dust and pollution levels. It’s a small thing, but it makes a significant difference over time.
4. Unlisted Vendor
India’s solar market is growing fast, but not every installer is authorized or experienced. People often hire local vendors who offer low quotes, only to realise later that they can’t assist with net metering, government subsidies, or after-sales service.
Without proper certification, your system might not even qualify for state-level incentives.
Saatvik Solar is not only MNRE-certified but also backed by the trust of hundreds of clients across India. When you choose the best solar company in India, you ensure your system is legally compliant and eligible for all benefits.
5. Ignoring Net Metering and Government Approvals
Many people focus only on the hardware and forget to ask about net metering, grid connections, and local DISCOM approvals. Without these, your solar system becomes a standalone setup, limiting your savings and return on investment.
People often say, “My system is working, but I still get high electricity bills.” That’s usually because the net metering was never processed, or the system wasn’t approved by local authorities.

Q1. Can I save money by choosing cheaper solar panels?
While low-cost panels may seem attractive, they often lack durability and efficiency. It’s better to invest in quality panels from a trusted solar panel manufacturer in India for long-term performance and savings. Always choose panels that are ALMM approved, BIS certified, and come with all required manufacturer warranty certificates.
Q2. How important is the direction and angle of solar panels?
Extremely important! Even the best panels will underperform if not installed at the correct angle and direction. In India, south-facing panels with the right tilt generate the most energy.
Q3. Why is space for cleaning and maintenance necessary?
Without proper walkway access, cleaning panels becomes risky or impossible, leading to dirt buildup, lower output, and higher maintenance costs over time.
Q4. What happens if I don’t apply for net metering?
Without net metering, any excess electricity generated goes to waste instead of being credited to your bill. You miss out on savings and government benefits.

TOPCon Solar Panels: Why They Are the #1 Best Choice for Businesses & Homes in India?
All Blogs
The world is rapidly electrifying due to the increasing power demand, which is rising daily. Choosing the right solar energy is a prerequisite not only for generating electricity but also for securing long-term efficiency, value, and sustainability. One such breakthrough upon which everyone can rely without any second thought for future-proof energy independence is TOPCon Solar Panels. It is ideal for both commercial and residential users, as TOPCon solar panels are emerging as the best solar panels in India for a cleaner and greener future.
At Saatvik Solar, we’ve consistently led the charge in adopting next-generation technology. We took a step ahead with our N-TOPCon G12R bifacial modules that stand as a testament to our commitment, offering optimized performance and unmatched reliability. But why TOPCon solar panels are so ideal? And why should businesses and homeowners consider it over conventional solar technologies?
Let’s explore.
TOPCon Solar Panels Technology: A Brief Explanation
TOPCon stands for Tunnel Oxide Passivated contact. It is an advanced cell architecture created based on well-established PERC (Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell) technology but elevates the level of efficiency and durability several steps further.
Generally, in a typical PERC cell, sunlight hits a silicon wafer and gets absorbed partially to generate electricity. However, energy loss due to recombination (electrons and holes cancel out) restricts its performance. TOPCon solar panels tackle this issue by including a thin oxide tunnel layer and a passivating contact layer, leading to a dramatic reduction in recombination and thereby refining both efficiency and longevity.
Benefits of using TOPCon Solar Panels in India
Here are the certain reasons why should all businesses and homeowners go ahead with TOPCon solar panels.
1, Higher Efficiency – More Power per Panel
The first and foremost compelling benefit of TOPCon Solar panels is high-end energy efficiency. Where the standard monocrystalline PERC modules project only 20-21% efficiency but the best solar panels in India i.e., TOPCon can push it beyond 22.5-23.5%.
For all the businesses and homeowners with limited rooftop or land space, this offered:
Greater power output per square meter.
Smaller installation with unmatched returns.
Diminished levelized cost of Electricity (LCOE).
Saatvik NTOPCon G12R modules are crafted to maximize this advantage. Infused with large wafers and bifacial architecture, they not only offer better front-side performance but also rear-side energy gain of up to 15%, based on the reflectivity of the surface.
2, Superior Temperature Coefficient – Better Output in Excessive Heat
India’s climate can be harsh sometimes, mainly in the regions where ambient temperatures exceed 45°C. Traditional modules tend to fail in terms of performance in such conditions. Thus, the demand for some good solar panels for homes rises and here the TOPCon solar panels shine.
TOPCon modules have a better temperature coefficient, mainly around -0.30%/°C compared to -0.36%/°C for PERC modules. It may seem like a minor difference but leads to high energy savings over the panel’s lifespan. It mostly works better in hot zones like Rajasthan, Gujarat, or Telangana.
Resulted in:
Less performance degradation in heat
Better annual energy yield
Stable returns across various seasons
3, Lower Degradation, Longer Lifespan
TOPCon Solar modules degrade gradually compared to older technologies. On average, PERC modules present a degradation rate of 0.55% per year, whereas TOPCon solar panels exhibit only 0.4% or lower.
Retaining more usable energy output
Less replacement or repowering costs
Long-term investment with high peace of mind
Saatvik provides warranty coverage of up to 30 years on power output for its TOPCon Solar panels because we trust in future-proof energy.
4, Bifacial Advantage – Capture More, Generate More
Searching for the best solar panels in India, Saatvik’s TOPCon solar modules come on top due to their bifacial design. It can absorb sunlight from both sides. When installed on a shiny or reflective surface like white membranes or sandy soils, it can lead to:
Up to 15% more energy gain
Higher CUF (Capacity Utilization Factor)
Unmatched ROI from the same area.
This feature makes our TOPCon solar panels specifically fit for commercial rooftops, ground-mounted places, and industrial sheds, under which reflectivity can easily be optimized.
5, Higher Durability and PID Resistance
Exceptional resistance to PID (potential-induced degradation) is present in TOPCon solar panels which is a common issue in high-voltage installations. Because of their N-Type Silicon base and robust passivation layers, these modules:
Are less prone to microcracks
Bear thermal cycling and UV exposure
Maintain high performance in coastal or humid environments
Saatvik’s Solar panels for home are certified under stringent international standards, including IEC, MNRE, BIS, and PV cycle compliance.
6, Ideal for Utility, Commercial & Residential Applications
For Businesses and Industries:
Enhanced Rooftop utilization with higher efficiency.
Enhanced ROI due to high annual yield.
Benefits through Net Metering & Peak demand shaving.
Supports ESG and CSR goals with high-performance green energy.
For Homeowners:
Swift breakeven due to higher output percentage
Minimal roof area required for solar panel installation
Residential subsidy ready as per PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
Offer long warranty with generational reliability
Saatvik guarantees in and out complete solar assistance, making adoption seamless for both sectors.
7, Cost vs. ROI: Is TOPCon Worth the Investment?
While TOPCon modules may have a slightly higher upfront cost in comparison to standard Mono PERC, the ROI they deliver for 25-30 years is significantly greater:

Saatvik’s solar panels’ price ensures that the cost-to-performance value always goes on the side of customers. Our tailored financial models are available for EPC, B2B, and government scheme integrations.
8, Sustainability Benefits – The Green Edge
TOPCon technology leads the way for cleaner and more sustainable energy generation by:
Reducing the carbon payback period
Assisting the low-carbon manufacturing processes
Promoting solar adoption in all high-demand urban zones
The push came from India’s walk towards net-zero emissions by 2070 and 500 GW of non-fossil energy by the end of 2030. Getting hold of TOPCon solar panels isn’t just a business decision—it’s a commitment to a cleaner environment.
Saatvik proudly moves forward to support this transition by producing TOPCon Solar panels in India. The manufacturing process is fully automatic involving all like robotics, smart motion controls, and zero-waste processes.
Saatvik Solar: Your Trusted Partner in TOPCon
Saatvik Solar doesn’t just manufacture TOPCon solar panels, we deliver end-to-end solar excellence. Right from product innovation to EPC execution, our commitment is rooted in:
Engineering Precision
Customer-centric solutions
Future-ready or Next-gen solutions
Our Flagship N-TOPCon G12R Bifacial modules are already powering the projects across India and Global markets. We are now not restricted to the territory of India but expanding to areas like the Middle East, America, Africa, and Southeast Asia.
TOPCon Solar Panels for a Smarter Future
Solar is neither a choice anymore nor only a means to save electricity, it’s more about powering a sustainable future, leading to energy independence, and building assets that last. With TOPCon solar panels, you are not going ahead with the best technology; you are choosing a smarter, more long-lasting, and more sustainable energy journey.
Whether you’re a homeowner looking to reduce your electricity bill or a business aiming for profitability and green compliance, Saatvik TOPCon solar panels are for you.

1. Can I use TOPCon solar panels in residential installation?
Yes, certainly. TOPCon solar panels in India are apt for residential installation use. These panels are sturdy and can stand well for up to 3 decades with proper maintenance.
2. How does TOPCon technology refine the overall solar panel efficiency?
TOPCon solar panels comprise a passive oxide layer, which plays a crucial role in carrying power charge from a solar cell to a semiconductor connected with it to deliver highly efficient performance. This feature refines the panel performance and takes it to the next level.

Bifacial ability
Environment friendly

The global energy landscape is undergoing a seismic shift; one thing is absolutely vivid: solar energy is not an alternative but the bedrock of the future of renewable energy. Under the Panchamrit action plan, India aims to achieve 500 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity by 2030. According to IEA, India’s annual renewable energy capacity installation is expected to quadruple from 15 GW in 2023 to 62 GW by 2030, the fastest among growing economies. And, to make it possible, solar energy comes on top. Even in an ecosystem filled with obstacles, solar power emerges as a scalable, sustainable, and smart solution.
It is not wrong to state, “Solar energy is the future of renewable energy.” To get an in-depth idea about the same and justification, explore this write-up till the end. So, let’s begin now.
A Peek into the Beginning of Solar Energy
Today, solar energy has evolved into a pillar of the future of renewable energy, transforming into a powerhouse of green energy. Take a look how it evolved.
“Did you know humans have used solar energy for thousands of years?” Yes, it is quite shocking but true. Ancient Greeks and Romans formed smart ways to heat their homes with the sun.
It all started in the 19th & 20th centuries with the invention of photovoltaic cells.
Bell Lab researchers like William Shockley, John Bardeen, and Walter Brattain invented it, laying the foundation for the present solar industry.
It hits its peak in the 1970s due to high investment in research and development. It was indeed a pivotal moment in the journey of making a brighter future filled with sustainable living.
Now, let’s dig into the meaning of solar energy and how it generates electricity.
What is solar energy, and how does it work?
All in all, solar energy is nothing else but power gained from the sun’s rays. Several technologies are used for this that are photovoltaic cells, solar thermal phenomenon, and concentrated solar power. But what is most prevalent nowadays is the PV module, which can convert sunlight directly into electricity in no time.
Sunlight is available everywhere, making solar power a democratized energy source in its true sense.
The procedure of solar panel working
Solar energy gets trapped in the photovoltaic cells of the solar modules.
These cells convert the sunlight directly into electricity by forming an electric field across all the silicon layers.
The generated electricity can be either used immediately or stored in batteries for further usage.
The Rise of Solar Energy in India as the Future of Energy
India is very blessed in a geographical manner, as it has over 300 sunny days annually, positioned to lead the future of energy at its helm. The target set by the Indian government, i.e.,280 GW of solar capacity by 2030, shows how much the nation wants to build a sustainable planet.
As a result, solar energy in India has become a driving agent in reducing the carbon footprint and gaining a sustainable position.
Uses of Solar Energy
If you think that solar energy can only be used to power up the house or businesses, you are completely wrong. Today, solar energy has various applications, such as
Agricultural irrigation through solar pumps.
Rooftop solar for all residential and commercial buildings.
Solar-powered streetlights and other equipment.
Industrial applications demanded clean electricity.
Charging stations for all-electric vehicles.
This wide array of use cases showcases the need for solar energy across various sectors.
Technological Advancements: Solar Modules Leading the Way
The ongoing evolution of solar modules is truly a game-changer. Now, high-efficiency technologies like Mono PERC and TOPCon come into the picture and are adopted by the best solar power companies in India, which are widening the boundaries by showing what solar modules can accomplish.
These next-gen modules are far better in every aspect, like offering better temperature coefficient, better performance under low-light conditions, and longer life spans, making relying on solar energy more viable than ever.
The Future of Energy: Why Solar Power Leads the Way?
In the quest for sources of renewable energy, solar energy emerged as the frontrunner in shaping the future of renewable energy for our nation. So, let’s explore why solar is poised to lead the way forward.
Abundance & Sustainability
Solar energy is all about the act of capturing the power of the sun; it provides a huge amount of energy in an hour ­­— more than our entire population can consume in a year. This abundance makes this energy a vital, limitless source that can fulfil our needs. By getting hold of this clean energy source, reduction of carbon footprints and mitigation of impacts of climate change become possible.
Environmental Benefits
One major benefit of solar power is that it has a close to negligible impact on the environment when compared to other conventional energy sources. There is no emission of gases or other pollutants. It is ideal for usage as it reduces the ecological footprint. By moving to solar power, you can effortlessly save natural habitats and cut down on environmental degradation.
Economic stream availability
The solar energy realm is indeed a hub of opening up economic opportunities across the world. The installation, manufacturing, and maintenance of solar plants give employment to a plethora of people. As businesses and governments invest in the renewable energy domain, they stimulate local economies, attract private sector investments, and foster innovation in clean technologies. That is not all; the economic benefits of solar energy will extend to rural and remote areas as well, promoting sustainable development.
Solar energy demonstrates a crucial journey towards forming a resilient future filled with energy.
The Role of Solar Power Companies
The emergence of solar power companies in India is what is driving the solar revolution. The focus of such companies is not only on manufacturing but also on providing all-in-all solar solutions. It included EPC (engineering, procurement, and construction) and O&M (operations and management).
The agile and integrated approach of these companies has amplified the level of customer satisfaction. It makes solar adoption easier for all individuals and enterprises.
The Future of Energy: Solar Power Energy
Looking ahead, the future of renewable energy seems decentralized, digitized, and decarbonized — and solar power is the fuel driving this transformation. Whether it is through on-grid systems, off-grid systems, or hybrid models integrating storage, solar will be the core of the global energy transition.
In the very next decade, what can come up?
Increased integration with electric mobility.
Smarter Solar modules with AI-infused for seamless performance optimization.
Expansion of floating solar and agrivoltaics.
Enhanced recycling and sustainability in the entire solar chain supply.
Ending Note!
The sun is not just a source of light; it is a source of life, mainly the source of sustainable energy for the world. Fulfilling all the checkpoints and building the future of renewable energy, solar energy emerges as the most promising path to take. With its scalability, minimal costs, and constant innovation, solar power truly appears as the future of energy. The vision of solar-laden India is not just a mere possibility but an impending reality with the emergence of several solar power companies.
Get hold of solar energy today to make the most use of the sun — today and tomorrow.
FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)
Why is solar energy considered the best renewable energy source?
Solar energy is a renewable energy source, as you can’t use it all up. It is clean. It creates zero carbon emissions or other heat-trapping “greenhouse” gases. Moreover, it avoids the environmental damage associated with mining or drilling for fossil fuels.
What is the reason behind believing solar is the future of renewable energy?
Solar energy comes out on top because no damage to the environment, even a bit, will be caused. It doesn’t hamper the environment and produces energy to the fullest to satisfy the needs of everyone.
Why does solar energy have a great future ahead in India?
Solar energy has a bright future in India. It cuts down the dependence on other sources like firewood and dung cakes, mainly in rural areas.
What 5 functions of solar energy can one leverage?
The five main uses of solar energy are:-
• Solar electricity
• Solar water heating
• Solar heating
• Solar ventilation
• Solar lighting

Saatvik Green Energy Limited (NSE & BSE listed) is one of India's leading solar PV module manufacturers, with an annual production capacity of 4.8 GW at its state-of-the-art facility in Ambala, Haryana, and a 2 GW in-house EPE film line supporting vertical integration. The company's portfolio spans Mono PERC and N-TOPCon solar modules, Uday Series grid-tied inverters, SuryaConnect solar kits, solar water pumps, transformers, and end-to-end EPC solutions. Saatvik serves customers across 10+ global markets and is expanding with a backward-integrated 4.8 GW cell and 4 GW module manufacturing complex in Odisha. CorporateDec 20, 2025
Abani Kant Jha Appointed Chairman of ASSOCHAM CFO Council
All Press Releases
Gurgaon| Dec 20. Abani Kant Jha, Group Chief Financial Officer of Saatvik Green Energy Limited, has been appointed Chairman of the CFO Council of ASSOCHAM.
As Chairman of the ASSOCHAM CFO Council, he will lead engagement among senior finance leaders across industries, focusing on key themes such as corporate governance, risk management, regulatory developments, capital allocation, and long-term value creation.
His role will involve shaping the Council’s agenda, fostering high-quality industry dialogue, and contributing actionable recommendations to support India’s evolving business environment.
Commenting on his appointment, Abani Kant Jha said, “It is a privilege to take on this responsibility at ASSOCHAM. The CFO’s role today is increasingly strategic, spanning governance, resilience, and sustainable growth. I look forward to collaborating with fellow finance leaders to contribute meaningfully to industry and policy discussions.”
Abani Jha brings over three decades of experience across finance, strategy, and operations. In his current role at Saatvik Green Energy Limited, he has been instrumental in strengthening financial discipline, supporting scale and growth initiatives, and guiding the company through key phases of its expansion in India’s renewable energy sector.
His appointment underscores ASSOCHAM’s emphasis on leveraging experienced finance leaders to steer industry conversations and reinforce the evolving role of CFOs as strategic partners in India’s growth story.
About Saatvik Green Energy Limited
Founded in 2015, Saatvik Green Energy Limited is a leading Indian renewable energy company offering end-to-end solar solutions across manufacturing and deployment. The company serves utility-scale, commercial, residential, and agricultural segments, supporting India’s transition towards a sustainable and energy-secure future. The Company operates a 4.8 GW module manufacturing facility in Ambala, Haryana. Saatvik is also developing a greenfield integrated facility in Odisha with 4 GW module and 4.8 GW solar cell manufacturing capacity, positioning the company as a multi-location, vertically integrated player at the core of India’s renewable energy build-out.

CorporateDec 30, 2024
Saatvik Solar appoints industry veteran Abani Kant Jha as Chief Financial Officer
All Press Releases
New Delhi, August 5, 2024: Saatvik Solar, India’s premier solar PV module manufacturer, has recently appointed Mr. Abani Kant Jha as its new Chief Financial Officer (CFO). With over 25 years of extensive experience across diverse industries, Mr. Jha brings unparalleled expertise to bolster Saatvik Solar’s financial leadership and drive its ambitious growth plans.
Mr. Jha is widely recognized for his exceptional leadership skills, financial acumen, and strategic analysis capabilities. His proficiency in implementing integrated business planning techniques across complex enterprises sets him apart in the industry. An engineer by training, Mr. Jha’s versatile career spans critical sectors including telecom, retail, technology, and industrial manufacturing.
Prior to joining Saatvik Solar, Mr. Jha served as Director of Business Operations & CFO at Jindal Films, where he spearheaded global manufacturing and sales strategies, explored lucrative M&A opportunities, optimized costs, managed risks effectively, and realigned focus on customer success. His illustrious career includes leadership positions in renowned organizations such as EaseMyTrip, Aditya Birla Group, DP World, and Reliance Industries.
Mr. Jha will oversee the finance department and collaborate closely with the management team to promote operational efficiency and boost financial performance in his new position as Chief Financial Officer at Saatvik Solar. His appointment underscores Saatvik Solar’s commitment to strengthening its executive team with top-tier talent to accelerate growth and innovation in the burgeoning solar energy sector.
Mr. Prashant Mathur, CEO of Saatvik Solar, expressed his enthusiasm about Mr. Jha’s appointment, stating, “We at Saatvik Solar are delighted to welcome Abani Kant Jha on-board the leadership team. His proven track record of financial stewardship and strategic insight aligns perfectly with our mission to drive sustainability and lead innovation in the renewables sector. Mr. Jha’s expertise will be instrumental in propelling our financial strategies and reinforcing our position as an industry leader.”
Speaking on the occasion, Mr. Abani Kant Jha said, “I am honoured to join Saatvik Solar as the CFO and am eager to contribute to its continued success. It is indeed an exciting opportunity for me to leverage my experience and collaborate with talented teams to achieve our strategic financial objectives, which align with the company’s vision of becoming one of India’s strongest and largest renewable energy companies.”
Adding to his impressive credentials, Mr. Jha has been serving as the Co-Chairman of ASSOCHAM (Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry of India) since April 2024. In this influential position, he represents the industry body in high-level meetings with ministers, senior government officials, policymakers, and regulators. His role is crucial in addressing sectoral issues, analyzing emerging trends, and formulating strategic roadmaps to propel the industry forward.
About Saatvik Solar
Saatvik Solar is India’s premier Solar PV Module manufacturer, dedicated to driving sustainable energy solutions for a brighter future. Founded in 2016 with a vision to revolutionize the solar industry, the company has established itself as a pioneer in the field. It operates a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility strategically located in Ambala, Haryana, and employs over 1200 employees. Saatvik Solar has swiftly evolved from a specialized module manufacturer into a fully integrated solar powerhouse. It now offers advanced module production and comprehensive EPC services for both Pan-India as well as global markets. This focus positions the company as a one-stop solution for solar energy needs. With an impressive 3.8 GW module manufacturing capacity as of FY24-25 and strategic expansion plans in progress, Saatvik Solar is not just participating in the solar industry—it’s actively shaping its future, reinforcing its commitment to India’s renewable energy landscape and solidifying its position as a leader in the global solar market.

How brand ambassadors can foster strong emotional connections between customers and brands
All Press Releases
Understanding the role of brand ambassadors in nurturing emotional bonds
Unlike traditional marketing tactics focused on promotions, brand ambassadors offer a unique perspective. They aren’t merely promoters but officially are the brand advocates who have indulged in first-hand experience with the brand’s value and are willing to share that experience with others on the basis of their personal experience with the brand.
Brands can develop a lasting relationship with customers by delivering authentic and genuine content. To ensure brand authenticity, brand ambassadors can play a crucial role in this aspect by providing genuine content based on their own experience which makes the overall journey not only more convincing but also resonates with the audience boosting brand visibility and engagement.
Similarly, credibility and trust are invaluable components in the business landscape. Since brand ambassadors have already been established as credible and reliable figures in their respective fields, their endorsements enhance public confidence in the brand, attracting and retaining new customers who rely on their trusted recommendations.
One of the most significant advantages of having brand ambassadors is their ability to amplify the company’s reach. These individuals have their own network of existing followers, whether on social media channels or professional circles but by leveraging these networks brands can target audiences that would have previously been inaccessible or difficult to engage.
Assimilating the power of brand ambassadors with storytelling
Today’s consumers seek not only quality services or products but also crave an immersive and meaningful experience that leaves the soul rejuvenated. Brand Ambassadors act as the most important asset in this aspect, given their ability to create emotional bonds by harnessing the power of storytelling, captivating the audience under a spell by sharing their personal stories which strengthen loyalty and trust towards the company.
A good story always backs up details with real anecdotes from people who have used the products or benefitted from the experience and who is better than Brand Ambassadors to do that? Their authentic stories highlight their experience connecting it with the brand’s purpose which strengthens both brand equity and value.
Successful stories are all about linking the core with what your brand stands for and revolving that around an inspirational or positive tale. Brand Ambassadors can facilitate the brand message by linking it with a personal inspirational story that connects with the brand’s persona delivering a positive experience to the customers.
Further, to show that a brand comes from humble beginnings and struggles as a business owner or the challenges that your employees face, storytelling leveraging the popularity of a face or voice of a reputed figure remains a great way to build strong emotional connections. This demonstrates consumers’ openness towards being vulnerable and honest.
Tips for effective brand-ambassador collaborations
The first and foremost step is to carefully select a brand ambassador that aligns with the brand’s value and identity. Secondly, they should be authentic and committed individuals willing to invest their time and efforts in representing the brand and delivering content that resonates with their target audience.
In addition, to ensure that your brand-ambassador collaborations run smoothly and continue to grow, brands can potentially offer them resources or incentives such as product samples or event invitations. Moreover, the brand can focus on recognising and rewarding the efforts of your brand ambassadors highlighting their success which will help foster a positive and supportive relationship with them as well as their fan following.
Bottomline
Establishing meaningful connections with consumers is essential and Brand Ambassadors have become a powerful tool in this aspect. They bring authenticity, relatability, credibility and human touch to the overall outlook of the brand. Through authentic content generation, they can foster emotional connections making them an invaluable resource in the longevity and success of any company.

At Saatvik, we have remained committed to robust governance, disciplined financial operations, and value-driven execution as we continue to strengthen our presence in the renewable energy sector. I view this recognition as a reaffirmation of our team’s integrity, resilience, and data-led approach in navigating today’s evolving energy landscape.”
Jha’s recognition is a testament to his strategic acumen and financial stewardship, demonstrated through efficient fiscal management and contribution to Saatvik Green Energy Limited’s growth trajectory in the renewable energy sector.

FinancialFeb 5, 2026
Q3 & 9M FY26 Earnings Release
All Press Releases
Saatvik Green Energy Limited delivers strong Q3 & 9M FY26 performance; driven by higher volumes, disciplined cost management and operating efficiency
Robust Order Book of 5.05 GW
Gurugram, February 4th, 2026: Saatvik Green Energy Limited (“the Company”) (NSE: SAATVIKGL, BSE: 544526), one of India’s leading solar PV module manufacturers, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended FY26.
Key Consolidated Financial Summary: –
Revenue for 9M FY26 stood at ₹29,407.8 million, registering a 137% growth over 9M FY25 driven by higher volumes and stable realizations.
Q3 FY26 revenue was ₹12,570.2 million, registering a 143% growth over Q3 FY25.
EBITDA for 9M FY26 stood at ₹4,693.4 million, up 135% YoY, translating into an EBITDA margin of 15.96% reflecting disciplined cost management and operating efficiency.
Q3 FY26 EBITDA stood at ₹1,647.6 million up 134% YoY, with an EBITDA margin of 13.11%.
Profit After Tax (PAT) for 9M FY26 came in at ₹3,007.9 million, reflecting a 145% YoY increase, with a PAT margin of 10.23%. Q3 FY26 PAT stood at ₹987.2 million up 144% YoY.
Operational Highlights:
Total production during Q3 FY26 stood at 759 MW.
Capacity utilization during Q3 FY26 remained at approximately 81%, significantly above industry averages.
Ambala manufacturing facility is operating at an annual capacity of 4.8 GW, supported by strong demand across utility-scale and C&I segments.
Order book remains healthy at approximately 5.05 GW, providing clear visibility for the coming quarters.
Business & Strategic Updates:
The Greenfield integrated manufacturing facility in Odisha is on track, comprising 4 GW of solar module capacity and 4.8 GW of solar cell capacity, which remains on schedule.
The project represents a key milestone in Saatvik’s backward integration strategy, aimed at improving cost competitiveness and long-term margin sustainability.
Successfully commissioned and operationalized a 2 GW in-house EPE (Protective Encapsulant) film manufacturing facility at its Ambala campus in Haryana
Key Consolidated Financial Summary:
Management Commentary
Commenting on the performance, Mr. Prashant Mathur, CEO, Saatvik Green Energy Limited, said:
Q3 FY26
“Q3 FY26 was a strong quarter for Saatvik Green Energy, with revenues reaching ₹12,570.2 million, driven by robust demand for solar modules, high-capacity utilization and continued traction from repeat customers. EBITDA stood at ₹1,647.6 million, with margins at 13.11%, reflecting operating leverage and improved cost efficiencies.”
PAT
“Profit after tax increased to ₹987.2 million, with PAT margins of 7.85%, underscoring the strength of our operating model. For the nine months ended FY26, we delivered healthy year-on-year growth across key financial metrics, supported by higher volumes, improved asset utilization and disciplined execution. Return ratios remained strong, with ROE at 23.10% and ROCE at 26.03%, reflecting efficient capital deployment and improving profitability.”
Operational performance
“Operational performance remained robust, with capacity utilization at 81.00% during the quarter. As of 31st December 2025, our order book stood at 5.05 GW, providing strong revenue visibility. During the period, we secured repeat domestic orders aggregating ₹963 crore from leading IPPs and EPC players, reaffirming confidence in our product quality and execution capabilities.”
BALANCE SHEET
“Our balance sheet continued to strengthen, with the debt-equity ratio improving to 0.66, reflecting a meaningful reduction in leverage and enhanced financial flexibility. This supports our planned capacity expansion and backward integration initiatives in a disciplined manner.”
ODISHA MANUFACTURING EXPANSION
“The Greenfield integrated manufacturing facility in Odisha is on track, comprising 4 GW of solar module capacity and 4.8 GW of solar cell capacity. The project represents a key milestone in Saatvik’s backward integration strategy, aimed at improving cost competitiveness and long-term margin sustainability. With a focus on technology, quality, and execution, Saatvik aims to play a meaningful role in India’s renewable energy transition.”
EPE MANUFACTURING FACILITY
SGEL has successfully commissioned and operationalized a 2 GW in-house EPE (Protective Encapsulant) film manufacturing facility at its Ambala campus in Haryana. The facility, co-located within the company’s existing module manufacturing complex, represents a significant milestone in Saatvik’s journey toward deeper vertical integration and supply-chain self-reliance.
SGEL now joins a select group of Indian manufacturers with captive encapsulant production capability, a critical component in high-performance solar PV modules. The commissioning of the EPE film line strengthens the company’s control over product quality, operational efficiency, and long-term module reliability while supporting India’s Make in India and Atmanirbhar Bharat manufacturing ambitions.
UDAY SERIES OF INVERTERS
Saatvik has strengthened its integrated solutions portfolio with the UDAY Series of on-grid solar inverters, expanding into the B2C and distributed solar ecosystem. The launch of our UDAY Series of on-grid inverters advances our goal of offering integrated solar solutions, positioning us for sustained growth in the renewable energy sector. The UDAY Series inverters, available in the 1.1 kW to 50 kW range, feature MPPT efficiency >99%, Wi-Fi/4G/Ethernet/BLE connectivity, and IP65-rated weather protection, making them ideal for both residential and commercial solar installations.
SOLAR PUMP BUSINESS
SGEL has received an order from Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (MSEDCL) for the design, manufacture, supply, transportation, installation, testing, and commissioning of Off-Grid DC Solar Photovoltaic Water Pumping Systems (SPWPS) across identified farmer sites in Maharashtra. The order, awarded under the Magel Tyala Saur Krushi Pump Yojana / PM-KUSUM-B scheme, comprises the supply of 1,815 solar water pumps of 3 HP, 5 HP, and 7.5 HP capacity aggregating to an approximate order value of ₹30.24 crore (exclusive of GST). Under the scope of the contract, Saatvik Green Energy Limited will also provide complete system warranty, repair and maintenance services, and a remote monitoring system for a period of five years, ensuring long-term performance reliability for farmers.
LOOKING AHEAD
Looking ahead, supported by favourable policy tailwinds and rising renewable energy adoption in India, we remain confident of sustaining growth momentum. Our priorities include timely execution of expansion plans, improving asset utilization, strengthening return metrics and delivering long-term profitable growth.”
About Saatvik Green Energy Limited:
Saatvik Green Energy Limited is one of India’s leading solar photovoltaic module manufacturers, with a strong presence across utility-scale, commercial & industrial, EPC, and distributed solar segments. The Company currently operates a 4.8 GW module manufacturing facility in Ambala, Haryana, and is developing a Greenfield integrated manufacturing facility in Odisha with 4 GW module and 4.8 GW solar cell capacity. With a focus on technology, quality, and execution, Saatvik aims to play a meaningful role in India’s renewable energy transition.

All Press Releases
Saatvik Green Energy Ltd earns EcoVadis Bronze Medal with a score of 69/100, ranking in the 79th percentile globally
Recognition reinforces the company’s commitment to ESG-led growth and alignment with global sustainability standards
New Delhi, March 26, 2026: Saatvik Green Energy Limited, one of India’s fastest-growing fully integrated renewable energy companies listed on the BSE and NSE, has been awarded the Bronze Medal by EcoVadis, a globally recognized provider of business sustainability ratings. In a significant milestone for the Company, this marks Saatvik’s first-ever EcoVadis recognition, positioning it among a select group of companies globally acknowledged for their sustainability performance.
Saatvik achieved a score of 69/100, placing it in the 79th percentile among all companies assessed globally, reflecting a strong debut performance on the global ESG benchmark. The assessment evaluated the Company’s policies, practices, and disclosures across four critical themes: Environment, Labor & Human Rights, Ethics, and Sustainable Procurement.
EcoVadis evaluates over 130,000 companies globally, with ratings based on leading international standards, including the UN Global Compact Principles, International Labour Organization (ILO) conventions, Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) standards, and ISO 26000 guidelines. The rating provides a rigorous, evidence-based assessment while also serving as a roadmap for continuous improvement.
Securing this recognition in its very first assessment cycle underscores the strength of Saatvik Green Energy Limited sustainability foundation and its accelerated alignment with global ESG frameworks. The achievement highlights the Company’s focused efforts toward embedding Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles into its core business strategy.
The Company has been actively driving initiatives aimed at minimizing environmental impact, strengthening responsible sourcing practices, fostering an inclusive workplace, and ensuring ethical governance across its value chain.
Commenting on the milestone, Mr. Prashant Mathur, CEO, Saatvik Green Energy Limited, said: “Achieving the EcoVadis Bronze Medal in our very first assessment is a defining validation of Saatvik’s sustainability-first approach. This recognition is not just an endorsement of our ESG practices—it is a critical benchmark that strengthens our credibility with global customers, investors, and partners who increasingly prioritize responsible and transparent businesses. As we scale, this certification reinforces our ability to compete in international markets while staying deeply aligned with global sustainability standards. At Saatvik, we see ESG not as a compliance requirement, but as a core driver of long-term value creation and resilient growth.”
From a strategic standpoint, this maiden EcoVadis rating significantly enhances Saatvik’s global credibility, strengthening its positioning among customers, investors, and partners who increasingly prioritize ESG performance. It reinforces the Company’s readiness to compete in international markets and meet evolving sustainability expectations.
About Saatvik Green Energy Limited
Saatvik Green Energy Limited is one of India’s leading solar photovoltaic module manufacturers, with a strong presence across utility-scale, commercial & industrial, EPC, and distributed solar segments. The Company currently operates a 4.8 GW module manufacturing facility in Ambala, Haryana, and is developing a Greenfield integrated manufacturing facility in Odisha with 4 GW of module capacity and 4.8 GW of solar cell capacity. With a focus on technology, quality, and execution, Saatvik aims to play a meaningful role in India’s renewable energy transition.

Saatvik Green Energy Bags ₹171.45 Crores Order for Supply of Solar Modules for a Utility-Scale Solar Project
All Press Releases
Received an order worth ₹171.45 crore for the supply of high efficiency Topcon Solar PV Module
Order to be executed by October 2026.
This win further strengthens Saatvik’s growing order book and reaffirms its standing as a preferred domestic supplier for India’s most ambitious clean energy projects.
Gurugram, 26th May, 2026: Saatvik Green Energy Limited today announced that it has received and accepted an order aggregating to ₹₹171.45 crore for a domestic independent power producer.
The modules being supplied are TOPCon Bifacial Glass-Glass Solar PV Modules, a latest-generation solar technology that generates power from both sides of the panel, not just the front, significantly increasing energy output compared to conventional modules. Built with glass on both faces instead of the traditional plastic backsheet, these modules are also more durable and better suited to the demanding conditions of large open-ground solar farms, where long-term performance and weather resilience are critical.
Commenting on the development, Mr. Prashant Mathur, CEO, Saatvik Green Energy Limited, said, “This order is a strong reflection of the trust that leading project developers place in Saatvik’s manufacturing capabilities and product quality. Being selected to supply modules for a domestic independent power producer of this magnitude at one of India’s most important solar sites is a meaningful endorsement of what we have built. We remain committed to delivering on time and to the highest standards, as India accelerates towards its 500 GW clean energy target.”
This order adds meaningfully to Saatvik’s growing order book and consolidates its position as a preferred domestic supplier in the utility-scale solar segment. It also reflects a broader and accelerating industry trend, leading project developers and EPC players are increasingly choosing high-quality, locally manufactured solar modules over imports, driven by reliability, service assurance, and alignment with India’s Make in India policy push. Saatvik, with its expanding manufacturing footprint and investments in next-generation solar technologies, is well-placed to capitalise on this shift.

Saatvik Green Energy Limited is one of India’s leading solar photovoltaic module manufacturers, with a strong presence across utility-scale, commercial & industrial, EPC, and distributed solar segments. With a focus on technology, quality, and execution, Saatvik aims to play a meaningful role in India’s renewable energy transition.

text:
CSRMay 29, 2025
Saatvik Green Energy Celebrates 10 Glorious Years of Clean Energy Excellence
All Press Releases
Gurgaon, May 29, 2025 — Saatvik Green Energy Limited (“SGEL”), one of India’s fastest growing module manufacturing companies in India, marks a significant milestone today as it celebrates its 10-year anniversary. Founded on May 29, 2015, SGEL has established itself as one of the key players in India’s solar energy market.
SGEL was incorporated as a private limited company under the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, under the name ‘Saatvik Green Energy Private Limited’, pursuant to a certificate of incorporation dated May 29, 2015. SGEL was subsequently converted from a private company to a public company, pursuant to resolutions passed by its Board on September 20, 2024 and by its Shareholders dated September 21, 2024, consequent to which its name was changed to “Saatvik Green Energy Limited.”
Since inception, SGEL has supplied more than 2.00 GW high-efficiency solar PV modules domestically and internationally. The company is recognized as one of the few companies with capabilities in module manufacturing as well as engineering, procurement and construction (“EPC”). (Source: CRISIL Report) SGEL is one of the leading EPC companies in India with 69.12 MW of an installed EPC base in Fiscal 2024. (Source: CRISIL Report) SGEL also provides operations and maintenance (“O&M”) services to customers primarily in relation to the EPC projects undertaken by it.
Reflecting on this journey and the road ahead, Mr. Prashant Mathur, CEO, Saatvik Green Energy Limited, said: “Our initiative to achieve backward integration into cell manufacturing is a critical step in our long-term growth and sustainability objectives. The company is expanding its manufacturing capacity with plans to set up an integrated cell and module manufacturing facility in Odisha. The new facility will have a cell line manufacturing capacity of 4.80 GW, which is expected to be operational in Fiscal 2027; and a module production capacity of 4.00 GW, which is expected to be operational in Fiscal 2026. In addition, SGEL also intends to establish a manufacturing facility for the production of ingots, cells and wafers in Mohasa – Babai, Madhya Pradesh.”
Celebrating the 10th anniversary of SGEL, Mr. Neelesh Garg, Chairman and Managing Director, added: “We intend to grow our customer base in both India and internationally by leveraging our reputation for solar modules and reliable EPC services. We aim to enter new markets and strengthen our presence in existing ones by offering innovative, cost-effective solutions tailored to diverse energy needs.”
Mr. Manik Garg, Managing Director, shared: “We intend to expand our distribution network across India to make our solar solutions more accessible to customers nationwide. We have already established regional warehouses across major Indian states such as Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Kerala and Madhya Pradesh. These warehouses serve as central points for solar module storage and distribution to ensure timely delivery to installers and end customers. We intend to collaborate with local distributors in various states that will enable us to have deeper market penetration, particularly in Tier II and Tier III cities. This will also help us to ensure that solar products are accessible even in remote areas, accelerating the adoption of solar energy across the country.”
SGEL commenced its manufacturing operations in 2016 and has over the years expanded its annual installed capacity, from 125 MW as of March 31, 2017 to about 3.80 GW as of February 28, 2025. Its revenue from operations has grown from ₹4,799.50 million in Fiscal 2022 to ₹10,879.65 million in Fiscal 2024 at a CAGR of 50.56%. Its EBITDA in Fiscal 2022 was ₹147.66 million and has grown to ₹1,568.44 million in Fiscal 2024 at a CAGR of 220.00%.
SGEL currently operates three module manufacturing facilities in Ambala, Haryana (together, the “Ambala Facilities”) spread across a total land area of 724,225 square feet, which together form one of the largest single location module manufacturing facilities in India. (Source: CRISIL Report) SGEL is in the process of adding a capacity of 1.00 GW in one of its module manufacturing facilities in Ambala, which is expected to be operational in the first quarter of Fiscal 2026, thereby increasing its installed capacity at its Ambala facilities to a cumulative 4.80 GW.
About Saatvik Green Energy Limited
Headquartered in Gurugram, SGEL is one of India’s leading module manufacturers, in terms of operational solar PV module manufacturing capacity, with an operational capacity of approximately 3.80 GW modules as of February 28, 2025. The SGEL offers Mono PERC and N-TopCon modules, EPC services, and O&M capabilities.

text:
FinancialMay 20, 2026
Saatvik Green Energy Crosses ₹45,484 Mn in FY26 Revenue, Emerges as India's Integrated Renewable Powerhouse
All Press Releases
Editor’s Synopsis
FY26 revenue from operations grew by 111% YoY to ₹45,484 Mn, marking the Company’s highest-ever annual revenue performance.
Q4 FY26 revenue from operations stood at ₹16,077 Mn, reflecting 75% YoY growth.
Highest-ever annual production achieved during FY26 at 3,162 MW, with effective capacity utilization of 84.07%.
FY26 EBITDA stood at ₹5,811 Mn, up 62% YoY, while PAT increased 64% YoY to ₹3,571 Mn — the highest-ever profitability performance for the Company.
Order book stood at approximately 5.89 GW as of March 31, 2026, providing strong medium-term business visibility.
Debt-equity ratio improved significantly from 1.34 in FY25 to 0.65 in FY26, reflecting stronger balance sheet positioning.
Odisha integrated manufacturing facility remains on track, with Phase 2 solar cell expansion revised upward from 2.4 GW to 3.6 GW; tool moving expected to commence from Q1 FY27.
Commissioned a 2 GW in-house EPE encapsulant manufacturing facility and announced expansion plans to scale capacity to 5 GW.
Announced planned entry into ingot and wafer manufacturing with a proposed capacity of 6 GW, advancing Saatvik’s full value chain integration roadmap.
The Solar Pump business achieved remarkable multifold growth in FY26, with revenues surging nearly 19 times — from ₹25 million to ₹472 million.
National, 20th May 2026: Saatvik Green Energy Limited, one of India’s leading integrated solar energy solutions providers, announced its audited financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026 (Q4 & FY26).
The Company reported strong operational and financial performance during FY26, with revenue from operations growing by 111% year-on-year to ₹45,484 Mn, supported by sustained business momentum, manufacturing scale-up, and continued execution across key solar segments. During the year, Saatvik further strengthened its manufacturing footprint, diversified its solutions portfolio, and continued investments toward building a fully integrated solar manufacturing ecosystem.
The Company’s ongoing expansion initiatives, diversified clean energy portfolio, and continued backward integration efforts continue to strengthen Saatvik’s positioning across utility-scale, distributed solar, EPC, and integrated energy solutions segments. During the year, the Company further expanded its offerings across advanced PV modules, inverters, transformers, energy storage solutions, and turnkey energy solutions, while maintaining focus on high-efficiency and differentiated product offerings aimed at supporting customer value creation, operational reliability, and long-term margin resilience.
Commenting on the performance, Mr. Prashant Mathur, Chief Executive Officer, Saatvik Green Energy Limited, said, “FY26 was a defining year for us, marked by our successful listing on the Indian stock exchanges and the delivery of our highest-ever Revenue, EBITDA and PAT performance. Supported by strong order execution, manufacturing scale-up and growing customer relationships, we achieved our highest-ever annual production of 3,162 MW with effective capacity utilization of 84.07%, further strengthening our position as one of India’s fastest-growing renewable energy companies.”
“Our Ambala facility continues to operate at its full 4.8 GW module manufacturing capacity, while our Odisha integrated manufacturing project remains on track and represents a key milestone in Saatvik’s journey towards full value chain integration. During the year, we expanded our Odisha solar cell capacity plan from 2.4 GW to 3.6 GW, commissioned a 2 GW in-house EPE encapsulant manufacturing facility with expansion plans to 5 GW, and announced our planned entry into ingot and wafer manufacturing with a proposed 6 GW capacity.”
He further added, “FY26 also marked important strategic milestones across our clean energy solutions portfolio. Our order book stood at 5.89 GW with leading IPPs and utilities, while we expanded into transformer manufacturing, launched the UDAY Series of on-grid inverters, and strengthened our presence across hybrid and off-grid inverters and BESS solutions with B2C solar kits set to launch soon.”
“Our sustainability efforts were also recognized globally as Saatvik was awarded the Bronze Medal by EcoVadis and ranked in the 79th percentile among assessed companies worldwide. Supported by favourable policy initiatives and India’s long-term renewable energy ambitions, we believe Saatvik is strongly positioned for its next phase of growth with expanding manufacturing capacities, stronger integration and sharper execution capabilities,” he added.

Operational & Strategic Highlights (FY26)
Highest-ever annual production during FY26 stood at 3,162 MW, supported by effective capacity utilization of 84.07%.

Ambala facility continued operations at 4.8 GW module manufacturing capacity during FY26.
Odisha integrated facility comprising 4 GW module and expanded 3.6 GW Phase 2 solar cell capacity remained on track, with tool moving expected to commence from Q1 FY27.
Successfully commissioned a 2 GW EPE encapsulant manufacturing facility with plans to expand capacity to 5 GW.
Announced plans for entry into ingot and wafer manufacturing with a proposed capacity of 6 GW.
Expanded product portfolio through launch and development of hybrid inverters, off-grid inverters, B2C solar kits, transformer manufacturing and BESS-related solutions.
Solar Pump business revenues scaled from ₹2 crore to ₹47 crore during FY26.
Outlook
Saatvik enters FY27 with a strong strategic roadmap centered around manufacturing integration, product diversification, and operational scale-up.
Key focus areas for the coming year include:
Advancing Odisha integrated manufacturing expansion and commencement of tool moving activities from Q1 FY27.
Scaling integrated module, solar cell, encapsulant, ingot and wafer manufacturing capabilities.
Strengthening presence across distributed solar, inverter, transformer, Solar Pump and BESS ecosystems.
Expanding high-efficiency and value-added product offerings across domestic markets.
Continuing operational efficiency initiatives, backward integration and disciplined capital allocation.
The Company remains committed to supporting India’s renewable energy ambitions by enabling reliable, scalable, and affordable solar energy deployment through integrated manufacturing and technology-led clean energy solutions.
About Saatvik Green Energy Limited
Saatvik Green Energy Limited is one of India’s leading solar photovoltaic module manufacturers, with a strong presence across utility-scale, commercial & industrial, EPC, and distributed solar segments. The Company currently operates at 4.8 GW module manufacturing facility in Ambala, Haryana, and is developing a Greenfield integrated manufacturing facility in Odisha with 4 GW of module capacity and 4.8 GW of solar cell capacity. With a focus on technology, quality, and execution, Saatvik aims to play a meaningful role in India’s renewable energy transition.

Saatvik Green Energy Enters into Power Equipment Manufacturing Acquiring 80% Stake in Melcon Transformers
All Press Releases
Solar energy firm signals shift from pure-play generation to a broader energy infrastructure
Editors’ Synopsis
Saatvik Green Energy Limited acquires 80% equity stake in Melcon Transformers and Electricals Private Limited
Melcon is a Jaipur-based transformer manufacturer, incorporated in 2005, with its manufacturing facility situated at Alwar
Acquisition gives Saatvik a manufacturing footprint in power transmission equipment, a segment directly linked to India’s renewable energy scale-up
New Delhi, April 23, 2026: Saatvik Green Energy Limited, one of India’s leading solar energy companies, today announced the acquisition of an 80% equity stake in Melcon Transformers and Electricals Private Limited, a Jaipur-based transformer manufacturer. The Share Purchase Agreement was signed on April 23, 2026.
Melcon, incorporated in 2005 operates at the very backbone of the power ecosystem designing and manufacturing transformers that enable reliable transmission and distribution of energy. Its portfolio spans oil-type, dry-type, auxiliary, and energy-efficient transformers ranging from 5 KVA to 12,500 KVA (up to 33 KV class), addressing diverse industrial and utility requirements. Backed by a strong and consistent repeat order book from leading PSUs and reputed private and listed companies, Melcon has built both credibility and scale in a highly technical domain.
Commenting on the development, Mr. Prashant Mathur, CEO, Saatvik Green Energy Limited Said, “India’s energy transition will not be defined by capacity alone, but by the strength of the ecosystem that supports it. At Saatvik, we are building that ecosystem with intent and precision. Our acquisition of Melcon is a strategic step towards deepening our control across the power value chain. By integrating transformer manufacturing, we are not just adding a capability we are enhancing execution speed, ensuring quality assurance, and creating a more resilient and responsive supply chain. Transformers are a critical bridge between generation and consumption. Without robust transmission infrastructure, renewable capacity cannot translate into reliable power. We are consciously evolving from being a solar manufacturer to becoming an integrated energy solutions player one that doesn’t just participate in India’s clean energy growth but actively shapes and enables it at scale.”
The acquisition is expected to create meaningful synergies with Saatvik’s core solar business, including greater supply chain control, better execution efficiency, and the ability to offer more integrated energy solutions to its customers.
India’s renewable energy sector is witnessing unprecedented growth, driven by government targets of 500 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity by 2030. As the country scales up its green energy infrastructure, reliable power transmission and efficient distribution networks become as important as generation. Saatvik’s latest move positions it to play a larger role in this expanding opportunity.
About Melcon Transformers & Electricals pvt ltd
Melcon Transformers and Electricals Private Limited is an ISO 9001-certified manufacturer and exporter of power and distribution transformers up to 10 MVA, 33 kV class, including customized solutions. Founded in 2005 by Er. R.K. Jain, a first-generation entrepreneur and technocrat, and registered with ROC Jaipur, the company has built a strong reputation as a trusted player with a proven track record across India’s power sector.
About Saatvik Green Energy Limited
Saatvik Green Energy Limited is one of India’s leading solar photovoltaic module manufacturers, with a strong presence across utility-scale, commercial & industrial, EPC, and distributed solar segments. The Company currently operates a 4.8 GW module manufacturing facility in Ambala, Haryana, and is developing a Greenfield integrated manufacturing facility in Odisha with 4 GW of module capacity and 4.8 GW of solar cell capacity. With a focus on technology, quality, and execution, Saatvik aims to play a meaningful role in India’s renewable energy transition.

Saatvik Green Energy Expands into Solar Agriculture; Introduces Sustainable Pumps Across Maharashtra
All Press Releases
Mumbai, November 13, 2024: Saatvik Green Energy, one of India’s leading solar PV module manufacturers, has partnered with the Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (MSEDCL) to supply solar submersible pumps at 250 strategic sites across the state. The high-efficiency pumps range from 3HP to 7.5HP enhancing water access and supporting irrigation.
These are 100% stainless steel pumps with high-efficiency motor & controllers, suitable for various applications such as drinking water supply, livestock watering, pond management, and irrigation. They are approved by NABL accredited labs for performance & quality. This new product offering further strengthens Saatvik’s commitment to promoting sustainable solutions and advancing the role of renewable energy in India’s agricultural sector. Powered entirely by solar energy, these pumps ensure uninterrupted water supply for irrigation, even in remote areas with limited access to electricity.
Commenting on the same, Mr. Prashant Mathur, CEO, Saatvik Green Energy said, “Saatvik Green Energy is honored to collaborate with MSEDCL in advancing Maharashtra’s solar agenda. We aim to empower farmers with dependable, sustainable irrigation solutions that are both economically viable and environmentally sound. By reducing reliance on diesel and grid electricity, we are helping to pave the way for a greener, more resilient future for Maharashtra’s farming communities.”
Further, being an integrated solar module manufacturer, Saatvik Green Energy has been at the forefront of supplying high-quality Solar PV modules across Maharashtra, catering to major developers, government bodies, and commercial & industrial (C&I) customers. The company has also contributed to the success of the PM-KUSUM Yojana by providing solar PV modules to support sustainable agricultural practices. Some of Saatvik’s key clients include industry leaders such as Megha Engineering, Mahagenco, Oswal Pumps, BHEL, Variate, Photovoltaic Solar, Avaada & more. Recently, Saatvik also announced that it has won a ₹302 crore contract with Maharashtra State Power Generation Company Limited (MAHAGENCO) to supply 200 MW of its cutting-edge N-TOPCon 580Wp modules to various locations across Maharashtra.
Maharashtra stands at the forefront of India’s solar revolution, driven by ambitious renewable energy goals and proactive policies. With a target to reach 17.4 GW of solar capacity by 2025, the state promotes large-scale solar installations, rooftop solutions, and solar-powered agricultural initiatives like PM-KUSUM and the Surya Scheme. Solar submersible pumps have proven transformative in Maharashtra’s drought-prone regions, providing farmers with consistent, sustainable water access while easing pressure on the electricity grid. The state’s urban centers and industrial hubs, like Mumbai and Pune, also witness surging demand for solar power, underscoring Maharashtra’s position as a leader in India’s renewable energy transition.
About Saatvik Green Energy

Saatvik Green Energy Founders Neelesh Garg and Manik Garg Featured in Hurun India’s Top 200 Self-Made Entrepreneurs of the Millennia 2025
All Press Releases
Gurugram, India, Dec 22. Saatvik Green Energy Limited, one of India’s leading integrated renewable energy companies, announced that its founders, Manik Garg and Neelesh Garg, have been featured in IDFC FIRST Private Banking and Hurun India’s Top 200 Self-Made Entrepreneurs of the Millennia – 2025 Edition.
The prestigious list recognizes 200 of India’s most dynamic and influential self-made entrepreneurs and founders who are shaping the country’s new-age business landscape through innovation, leadership, and long-term value creation.
As part of this recognition, Manik Garg has also been named among the “Top Amongst the Youngest” entrepreneurs, highlighting his leadership journey and contribution to building Saatvik Green Energy Limited at a relatively young age.
The Hurun report features Saatvik Green Energy Limited in the Renewable Energy category, citing the company’s presence in the sector with a market valuation of INR 5,600 crore and its founding year of 2015, underscoring the scale, consistency, and impact of the enterprise built by the founders.
Commenting on the recognition, Neelesh Garg, Chairman and Managing Director, Saatvik Green Energy Limited, said: “This recognition is deeply humbling. It reflects not just an individual journey, but the collective effort of the entire Saatvik team that has believed in building a clean energy company grounded in quality, execution discipline, and long-term thinking. Being recognized among the youngest entrepreneurs is a responsibility to continue building with integrity and purpose.”
Manik Garg, Managing Director, Saatvik Green Energy Limited, added: “Nation building is not defined by scale alone, but by consistency, trust, and the ability to create responsible value over time. This recognition reinforces our belief that India’s renewable energy transition needs companies that combine strategic vision with strong execution on the ground.”
The founders’ inclusion in the Hurun list acknowledges their role in advancing India’s renewable energy transition, through a combination of technology-led innovation, operational strength, and sustainable manufacturing practices.
Over the years, Saatvik Green Energy Limited has emerged as a meaningful contributor to India’s clean energy ecosystem, serving utility-scale, commercial, and residential solar markets.
For Saatvik Green Energy Limited, the recognition serves as a reaffirmation of its founding philosophy, to build a future-ready clean energy enterprise anchored in trust, long-term vision, and responsible growth.
About Saatvik Green Energy Limited
Saatvik Green Energy Limited is an integrated solar energy solutions provider engaged in the manufacturing of high-efficiency photovoltaic (PV) modules and offering EPC services for utility-scale, commercial, and industrial projects. The Company operates a 4.8 GW module manufacturing facility in Ambala, Haryana. Saatvik is also developing a greenfield integrated facility in Odisha with 4 GW module and 4.8 GW solar cell manufacturing capacity, positioning the company as a multi-location, vertically integrated player at the core of India’s renewable energy build-out.

Saatvik Green Energy Launches Energy Storage Arm ‘Saatvik Power Storage Solutions Limited’ to Expand Beyond Solar Manufacturing
All Press Releases
Editor’s Synopsis
Saatvik Green Energy Limited has incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Saatvik Power Storage Solutions Limited, in India.
The subsidiary will focus on batteries and energy storage systems, strengthening Saatvik’s clean energy ecosystem.
The move aligns with the company’s strategy to expand beyond solar manufacturing and Projects into advanced energy storage and integrated renewable energy solutions.
The subsidiary plans to explore opportunities in 20 GW of energy storage capacity over the next five years
National, 13 March 2026: Saatvik Green Energy Limited, one of India’s fastest-growing fully integrated renewable energy companies listed on the BSE and NSE, has announced the incorporation of its wholly owned subsidiary, Saatvik Power Storage Solutions Limited, in India. The newly formed entity will operate in the renewable energy and energy storage sector, focusing on the development and deployment of battery technologies and energy storage systems.
The initiative marks an important step in Saatvik’s strategy to build a future-ready clean energy platform that integrates solar generation with storage solutions. The subsidiary plans to explore opportunities in 20 GW of energy storage capacity over the next five years, supporting grid stability and renewable integration across key markets. The company also aims to introduce utility scale, C&I, retail and residential range of battery and energy storage solutions, catering to utility-scale, commercial & industrial, and distributed renewable energy applications.
Commenting on the development, Prashant Mathur, CEO of Saatvik Green Energy Limited, said: “Energy storage will play a critical role in enabling the next phase of renewable energy growth. The incorporation of Saatvik Power Storage Solutions Limited reflects our long-term vision to build a comprehensive clean energy ecosystem that integrates solar manufacturing, EPC capabilities, and advanced storage technologies. This step positions Saatvik to contribute meaningfully to India’s transition toward reliable, round-the-clock renewable power.”
The subsidiary has been incorporated with an authorised capital of ₹10,00,000 divided into 1,00,000 equity shares of ₹10 each, with 100% shareholding held by Saatvik Green Energy Limited.
The establishment of the subsidiary reinforces Saatvik’s commitment to innovation, technology-led growth, and supporting India’s clean energy transition, particularly as the country accelerates deployment of renewable energy capacity supported by grid-scale and distributed storage solutions.
About Saatvik Green Energy Limited
Saatvik Green Energy Limited is one of India’s leading solar photovoltaic module manufacturers, with a strong presence across utility-scale, commercial & industrial, EPC, and distributed solar segments. The Company currently operates a 4.8 GW module manufacturing facility in Ambala, Haryana, and is developing a Greenfield integrated manufacturing facility in Odisha with 4 GW of module capacity and 4.8 GW of solar cell capacity. With a focus on technology, quality, and execution, Saatvik aims to play a meaningful role in India’s renewable energy transition.

Press ReleaseDec 1, 2025
Saatvik Green Energy Limited achieves prestigious CII-IGBC Green Factory Building silver rating for its Ambala manufacturing facility
All Press Releases
Ambala / Gurugram, November 28, 2025. Saatvik Green Energy Limited, one of India’s fastest-growing and fully integrated solar PV module manufacturers, has been awarded the prestigious IGBC Green Factory Building Silver Rating by the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) – Indian Green Building Council (IGBC) for its state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Ambala, Haryana.
This recognition marks a significant milestone in Saatvik’s commitment to sustainable, responsible, and future-ready manufacturing. The rating reflects the company’s strong focus on resource efficiency, environmental stewardship, and the creation of a healthy and resilient workplace ecosystem.
Saatvik’s Ambala plant demonstrated excellence across key green factory parameters, including:
· Efficient energy and water management across the facility
· Focus on renewable energy integration and carbon reduction
· Responsible waste reduction and recycling practices
· Healthy, safe, and future-ready workplace for our people
· Adoption of sustainable building materials and technologies
Saatvik Green Energy Limited was formally felicitated recently at the Green Building Congress 2025 at the Jio World Convention Centre, Mumbai. Leading organizations from across India were celebrated at the event for advancing the nation’s green building movement.
Speaking about the achievement, Mr. Prashant Mathur, CEO, Saatvik Green Energy Limited, said: “Receiving the IGBC Green Factory Building Silver Rating is a proud moment for all of us at Saatvik. It reflects our belief that sustainability must begin at the source, not just in the clean energy products we build, but in the way we design and operate our manufacturing ecosystems. Our Ambala facility embodies this philosophy, combining efficiency, environmental responsibility, and world-class quality. This recognition strengthens our resolve to accelerate our journey towards Net Zero manufacturing and contribute meaningfully to India’s clean energy transition.”
Saatvik’s sustainability-first approach aligns with its long-term strategy of scaling responsibly while ensuring that every module manufactured contributes to a cleaner planet, from origin to installation.
About Saatvik Green Energy Limited
Saatvik Green Energy Limited is an integrated solar energy solutions provider engaged in the manufacturing of high-efficiency photovoltaic (PV) modules and offering EPC services for utility-scale, commercial, and industrial projects. As of 30 September 2025, the Company operates a module manufacturing capacity of approximately 4.8 GW at its facility in Ambala, Haryana. Saatvik is also developing a greenfield facility in Odisha with integrated 4 GW module and 4.8 GW solar cell manufacturing capacity, positioning the company as a multi-location, integrated player at the core of India’s renewable energy build-out.

The award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at the company. Great Place To Work® is the global authority on workplace culture, employee experience, and the leadership behaviors proven to deliver high revenue, employee retention and increased innovation.
The certification is a result of an anonymous and confidential survey administered by the Great Place to Work® Institute, assessing employees’ trust in management, pride in their work, and camaraderie with colleagues..
Sarah Lewis-Kulin, the Vice President of Global Recognition at Great Place To Work® said: “Great Place To Work® Certification is a highly coveted achievement that requires consistent and intentional dedication to the overall employee experience. By successfully earning this recognition, it is evident that Saatvik Green Energy Limited stands out as one of the top companies to work for, providing a great workplace environment for its employees.”
According to Great Place To Work® research, job seekers are 4.5 times more likely to find a great boss at a Certified great workplace. Additionally, employees at certified workplaces are 93% more likely to look forward to coming to work, and are twice as likely to be paid fairly, earn a fair share of the company’s profits and have a fair chance at promotion.
About Saatvik Green Energy Limited
Headquartered in Gurugram, SGEL is one of India’s leading module manufacturers, in terms of operational solar PV module manufacturing capacity, with an operational capacity of approximately 3.80 GW modules as of February 28, 2025.
The SGEL offers Mono PERC and N-TOPCon modules, EPC services, and O&M capabilities. Its products cater to residential, commercial, industrial, and utility-scale segments with a focus on sustainability, reliability, and performance.
